samples.hyp: Okwekebejja omuwendo gw’okugezesa abantu bonna akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 ogulimu okusobola okutangira okusaasaana kw’akawuka mu kibuga Lusaka ekikulu mu Zambia nga waliwo n’abatalaba bubonero bw’akawuka:
Okunoonyereza okulwangu ku mutetenkanyirizo gwa kannakubala

Obulwadde bw’akawuka ka corona akapya (COVID-19), obuleetebwa akawuka ka kolona-2 akakosa omussizo (SARS-CoV-2), mu Afirika bulagiddwa okuba n’abantu bangi abatalaga bubonero (oba abalwala obulwadde obutono) abateeberezebwa okuba n’ekigendererwa mu kusaasaanya obuwuka.
Omuwendo era n’obuwuka bw’abalwadde abatali na bubonero bwa bulwadde tebunnyonnyolekeddwa bulungi.
Okunoonyereza okwo kyokka kulaga nti okubalagaza kye kyetaagisa okutangira okusaasaana kwa SARS-CoV-2.

Twakola omutetenkanyirizo omwangu gwa matekemateke gwa bantu abayinza okukwatibwa obulwadde, abalina obulwadde, abatalaga bubonero, n’abawonye (SEIR) okwekenneenya omulimu gw’okweggyawo abantu abalina COVID-19 nga tebalaga bubonero nga tukozesa okukebera abantu bonna okutangira obulwadde okusaasaana mu Disitulikiti ya Lusaka mu Zambia.
Wano twakola embeera bbiri; (1) nga tulowooza nti abantu abatalaga bubonero baali 70% ku bantu bonna abalina COVID-19 era (2) abantu abatalaga bubonero baali 50% ku bantu bonna abalina COVID-19.

Okugeraageranya, omutetenkanyirizo gwekebezebwa olubereberye nga kigambibwa nti abantu abatalaga bubonero ba kisiiga mu ngeri y’emu ng’abo abalaga bubonero, oluvannyuma ne lwa kubuulirira, era nga kisinga obutuufu, nga kigambibwa nti abantu abatalaga bubonero ba kisiiga kimu kya kubiri ku abo abalaga bubonero.

Mu mutetenkanyirizo ogutwala nti abantu abatalaga bubonero ba bitundu 70%, omuwendo omutono ogw’okukebera abantu bonna buli lunaku ogwa ≥ 7911 okukebera/abantu 100000 gwali gumala okulwanyisa obulwadde obubalukawo singa abantu abatalaga bubonero balina ekisiiga kya bitundu 50% kyokka, ate singa ekisiiga kyabwe kye kimu, omwendo gw’okukebera gwali gwa ≥ 10028 okukebera/abantu 100000.

Ku bantu abatalaga bubonero 50%, omuwendo omutono ogw’okugemesa abantu bonna ogwa ≥ 4540 okwekebera ku bantu 100000 gwali gumu ku gukendeeza ekirwadde ku mitindo gyombi egya kisiiga eri abantu abatalaga bubonero mu kwetula n’eri abantu abalaga bubonero.
Okukubaganya ebirowoozo n’okukubira

Omutetenkanyirizo gwaffe ogulaga nti okweggyawo abalwadde ba COVID-19, nga mw’otwalidde n’abatali na bubonero, okuyitira mu kukebera abantu bonna, kiyinza okukozesebwa ng’engeri emu ey’okutangira okusaasaana kwa SARS-Cov-2 mu Lusaka, Zambia, naye kijja kuba kya muwendo omungi.
Okwekebera abantu bangi mu bibuga ebinene nga Lusaka kiyinza okukendeeza okusaasaana kwa COVID-19, naye kiba kikolerwa bulungi?

Mu 2020, emitetenkanyirizo gya kompyuta yateebereza nti ensaasaana ya COVID-19 mu bibuga ebinene yandisobodde okufugibwa bulungi okuyitira mu kukebera abantu bangi, n’oluvannyuma okwawula abagenda okukebezebwa nga balwadde.
Wabula, abanoonyereza baagamba nti engeri eno eyinza okuba n’ebbeeyi era nga teyagwanika.
Ku ntandikwa y’omuwookeera, abantu bangi abaakwatibwa COVID-19 tebaalaga bubonero bwonna bw’ekirwadde, naye ne batwala ekirwadde eri abalala.
Ebyokunoonyereza ebimu biraga nti abantu abali wakati wa 50% ne 80% abalina COVID-19 tebaalina bubonero (obutalaga bubonero) era bayinza okuba nga be baavuddemu obuwuka obupya wakati wa 40% ne 70%.
Abanoonyereza baali baagala okumanya oba okunoonya n’okwawula abantu abatalaga bubonero kyandisobodde okuyamba mu kutereeza okusaasaana kwa COVID-19.
Era baayagala okumanya oba okukebeza abantu bangi mu bujjuvu, ekitegeeza okukebeza abantu bangi mu bukyamu, kizuula abantu abatalaga bubonero mu ngeri esobola okuganyulwa.
Abanoonyereza baakola omutetenkanyirizo gwa kompyuta oguteebereza engeri abantu gye bayita okuva ku kubeera nga bayinza okukwatibwa, okukwatibwa, okulwala, n’okweggyibwawo.
Baatunuulira obubaka okuva mu disitulikiti y’e Lusaka mu Zambia, ekyaŋŋamba ekya kampuni n’ekisaawe ky’ensi yonna ekikwatagana n’amawanga abiri.

Olw’okuba engeri COVID-19 gye yali ebonerera yali eky’enjawulo okuva ekifo ku kifo, baatunula embeera nnya, awamu obuwuka bwa COVID-19 obuli 50% oba 70% nga buli obutalaga bubonero, era obuwuka buno nga buli bwa buwuka obulwadde oba nga bwa buwuka obuli kimu ku bibiri eby’obuwuka obulwadde.

Omutetenkanyirizo gw’abanoonyereza gwalaga nti kyali kisoboka okukwata okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 nga bakola okukebera abantu bonna era nga bawummula abantu bonna abaazuulwamu obulwadde, ne bo abo abatalina bimujjo.
Baagamba nti okukendeeza omuwendo gw’abalwadde abasinga obungi ku bitundu 90% mu embeera zonna, abantu 10% mu Lusaka baali beetaaga okukeberwa buli lunaku.
Era baalaba nti singa twagala obuwuka obw’omukutu gwa Covid-19 obw’omukutu obw’omukutu obupya busigale nga bumu, abantu 22% baalina okwekebezebwa buli lunaku.
Wadde Zambia yateekawo enkola nyingi ezimenyawo okusaasaana kwa COVID-19, abantu abakwatibwa akawuka kaali akawona okuwonya.
Okwekebejja abantu bonna mu kibuga kitono eky’e Italy kyakendeeza omuwendo gw’abantu abalina COVID-19 n’ebitundu 90%.
Wabula, tewali kunoonyereza kwonna kw’emabega okwoleka nti kyandibadde kya mugaso mu kibuga kinene ekirala.

Kyetegeerezebwa nti abanoonyereza tebaakola kugezesa abantu bonna mu kunoonyereza kuno; wabula baakola omutetenkanyirizo ogulaga nti okwekebeza abantu bonna kwandibadde kukola okuyimiriza okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 mu bibuga ebinene.
Wabula, baalabula nti kirabika kijja kuba kya ssente nnyingi.
Era baagamba nti kiyinza okuba nga kikyangu okukikola singa kigattibwa ne mikolo emirala, gamba ng’omuggalo, okugezaako abantu ababadde ne muntu alwadde, n’okutema eddagala.
Abanoonyereza okuva mu Zambia era baategeeza nti abalwadde ba COVID-19 abatalaga bubonero baalabikanga nga bangi mu Afirika mu kiseera ekyo.
Okutono kwetaaga okukozesa obubonero bwa polygenic mu bantu b’omu Afirika olw’enjawulo mu ndagabutonde n’obuwangwa.
Abantu ba Afirika tebakiikirirwa bulungi mu kunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde, naye balina enjawulo ya ndagabutonde ennyingi era balina obubonero bw’obutonde obw’enjawulo mu nsi yonna.

Olw’okuba okwekebejja okutereezebwa obulungi okw’okuteebereza okw’endagabutonde tekannakoleddwa mu bantu abava mu Afirika abalina enjawulo, twabala obuwumbi bw’endagabutonde (PRS) mu kugezesa mu Afirika yonna ne mu bubaka obuva mu South Afirika, Uganda, ne UK okutegeera obulungi enkolagana y’okunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde.
Obuwanguzi bwa PRS bweyongera singa abantu abanoonyerezebwa bafanana mu buzaale okusinga okunoonyereza kw’abantu abatali bafaananagana mu buzaale.
Mu bantu ba South Afirika abalina obuwangwa n’ebika eby’enjawulo, tusanga nti obugenderevu bw’omugero gwa PRS buwanvu ku buli kibonero kyonna, naye bukyuka mu bibinja.
Enjawulo mu bazzukulu ba Bafrika zikwata nnyo ku nkyukakyuka mu bukozese bw’omugero gwa PRS okusinga enjawulo endala ez’ebibinja ebinene ebyalowoolezebwa wakati w’abantu mu Bungereza ne Uganda.

Twabala PRS mu bantu ab’omu Afirika nga tukozesa ebyo ebyaliwo eby’omu Bulaaya bokka, nga tubigeraageranya n’okunoonyereza okutunuulira enjawulo mu bantu; enjawulo eyongeddeyo eyingiza obugulumivu obusingawo ku kipimo kya puloteyini ya sukaali n’omuwendo gw’abantu ab’omubiri omumweru, ekiraga enjawulo enkulu ez’endagabutonde ez’omukisa mu ndagabutonde ezimanyiddwa okukwata ku ndwadde ya sickle cell n’okulwala okw’obuwuka, okusinziira ku buli kimu.
Enjawulo mu bukozeseza bw’omugero gwa PRS mu bantu ba Afirika abava mu bitundu eby’enjawulo, zikulu nga za bantu abava ebweru kwa Afirika, era ekyo kyetaaga okutegeera obulungi.
Lwaki tetusobola kuteesa bulungi endwadde ez’endagabutonde mu bantu abava mu Afirika.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola ezikozesebwa kati okuteesa oba omuntu ajja kulwala obulwadde obw’endagabutonde oba nedda tezikolera bulungi bantu abava mu Afirika.
Kino kuba nti obubaka obuli emabega w’okuteebereza okwo, obungi bwabwo bulaga endagabutonde z’abantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Obubaka bwa GWAS buyimirira “Okunoonyereza ku Bikola Endagabutonde Ebyawamu”, era abayizi b’amasomo ag’ebyenjigiriza bagikozesa okunoonya ebikolwa n’endwadde nga bakozesa endagabutonde.
Mu butuufu, basobola okukozesa GWAS okubala obulabe bw’endagabutonde bw’omuntu olw’obulwadde oba obulago.
Kyokka, ebubaka bwingi bw’endagabutonde mu GWAS buva ku bantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baali baagala okulaba obulungi bw’okubala kwe bakozesa okumanya obulabe bw’endwadde ez’endagabutonde nga bakozesa GWAS ku bantu abava mu Afirika.
Baagala era okulaba obanga okunoonyereza kwa GWAS okw’enjawulo, mu kwogera kwe okulala obubaka obulimu ebikozesebwa ku ndagabutonde za Bafirika, buyongera okutereeza ebyo ebyogerwa.
Okuwulira kuno kweyambisibwa mu ngeri za sayansi nga “polygenic risk score”, oba PRS.

Baakozesa kompyuta okubala obungi bw’obulabe obw’endagabutonde obuteeberezebwa eri abantu ba Afirika nga bakozesa GWAS, era baakozesa ebiwandiiko by’eby’obulamu by’abantu ba Afirika okulaba enfaanana oba endwadde ezisinziira ku nkyukakyuka mu ndagabutonde.
Bwe baakozesa GWAS ey’Ababulaya, baalaba nti omuwendo gw’obulabe bw’endagabutonde gwali mu bujjuvu obusinga singa abantu balina omuntu wa Bulaaya okusinga omuntu wa Afirika ku bintu bingi.
Baagamba nti obuwuka bw’obulabe buli wansi nnyo wakati w’ebitundu bya Afirika olw’okuba waliwo enjawulo nnyingi mu bantu, ekyo tekyogerera ku ebyo bye tulabye ku bantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Era baagamba nti obugenderevu bwa PRS bweyongera nga obutaka bwa Afirika bwe buseetera.
Abantu ba Ethiopia baalabika nga balina obusembayo obulungi mu kwesimba ku ndwadde ezivudde ku ndagabutonde kubanga balina obugattire mu ndagabutonde ng’abantu ba Bulaaya.
Bwe tukozesa GWAS eya njawulo ennyo erimu abantu abava mu Afirika, obugenderevu bw’okuteebereza bwongera.
Okuteebereza endwadde ez’omusaayi kyali kyennyini kya bugenderevu.
Okunoonyereza okw’emabega kulaze nti PRS mpeke eri abantu ba Afirika, ekitegeeza nti  omutindo gwa GWAS gulaga akabenje k’obutonde bw’omubiri obutono eri abantu abava mu Afirika.
Naye tukimanyi nti kino tekyali kituufu.

Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga nti obuwuka obutono bw’obulabe bw’endwadde mu ndagabutonde kuba endagabutonde z’Abafrika teziyimiriddwa bulungi mu bubaka bwa GWAS, era n’amagezi g’omuwendo gwa PRS agaliwo kati tegayamba nnyo mu kwesimba endwadde ez’endagabutonde mu Afirika.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti kyandibadde kirungi okukozesa obubaka obulungi obw’enjawulo obulimu obubaka ku ndagabutonde okuva mu bantu abava mu Afirika.
Kyeyava kibeetaagisa omulimu omugwo okugaziya okunoonyereza kwa GWAS okukwata n’abantu abava mu Afirika, tulyoke tutegeere bulungi enkizo y’endwadde ez’endagabutonde mu bantu ba Afirika.
Abawandiisi b’okunoonyereza kuno baali bava mu Afirika, USA ne Bungereza.
Okwekebejja okw’amaaso n’okwekebejja okw’obusembayo mu kuziyiza kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana n’ekitundu ky’omumwa gwa nabaana ekitali kya kookolo mu Namibia
Kigambibwa nti abakyala nga 851,340 mu Namibia bali mu kabi ak’okufuna akawuka ka HPV akasobola okuleeta kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana.
Okwekebeza ng’olaba n’akasito (VIA) n’okujjanjaba n’obusujju byaweebwa obujulizi obulaga nti bikola nnyo.
Kyokka, obubaka obukwata ku kukozesa kwa pulogulaamu z’okusunsula kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana tebuliwo.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakira okusonzesa okulongooseza n’okusonzesa okw’ekitundu ky’omubiri okutangira obulwadde bwa CIN n’ekookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana mu Namibia.

Ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti abakyala abalina akawuka ka HPV, obulwadde mu lubuto lw’omumwa, koilocytosis n’enkyukakyuka ezitali za bulijjo mu butaffaali balimu enkyukakyuka ey’okufuna omuwendo omulungi mu kukebera kwa VIA.
Abakyala abakulu, naddala abalina HIV, basobola okufuna kookolo w’olususu olusembayo (SCC).

Enkola ya VIA ebonerera okuba ey’omugaso mu kusunsula, wadde nti okukozesa colposcopy mu kugoberera abalwadde mu buwangwa bwa Namibia kyetaagisa okuddamu okulowoozebwa era ne kukozesebwa nga waliwo ebyavaamu ebirungi ebya HR-HPV.
Okuteesa okukozesa enkola ez’okusunsula okulimu okukebera akawuka ka HPV mu bibiina by’obukadde n’obulabe obw’enjawulo (e.g. abalina HIV, abalina obulwadde obwonoona obugonvu bw’omubiri) .

Okweyambisa okusunsula kuyinza okweyongera okutereezebwa mu ngeri ez’okujjanjabya ezikozesa omutetenkanyirizo ogukozesa ebyava mu kukebera obulwadde, ebiruubirirwa by’obulamu bw’abakazi, okumanya n’enkola ebikulu mu ggwanga.
Abakyala Abanamibiya abali mu kabi olw’okokolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana basaanidde okwekebezebwa era n’okujjanjubwa mu bwangu.
Ebigezo bingi bisobola okulaga obulabe bw’omukyala okuva mu kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana, naye okukebera buli kiseera mu Namibia tebikozesezza buli kiseera bino.
Abanoonyereza batendereza okukebera buli kiseera, okusobola okuzuula obubonero obw’okulabula mu bwangu, kino kiyinza okutaasa abakyala okuva mu ndwadde eno etta.
Kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana (kookolo w’ekitundu ekikadde eky’olubuto) gubaawo okufa kwa bakyala bangi mu nsi yonna.
Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okuleeta kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana kwe kawuka ka Human Papillomavirus (HPV).
Akawuka ka HPV konoona obutaffaali bw’omubiri gw’omukazi, ne kuteekawo ebiwundu ebiyitibwa obulema, ebiyinza okukoma okuba kookolo.
Wadde waliwo eddagala ery’okwewala akawuka ka HPV, abakazi bangi mu mawanga ga Afrika, nga mw’otwaliddeko Namibia, tebali na kyakukifuna.
Kino kitegeeza nti okwekebera akawuka oba obubonero bwe buleeta kikulu nnyo eri abakyala bano, kubanga y’engeri esingayo obulungi ey’okuyamba okwewala kookolo.
Abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti amalwaliro era yeetaaga obulagirizi obutuufu n’amawulire agakwata ku bikebero ebisinga obulungi okukozesa.
Baayongerako nti abakozi b’eby’obujjanjabi era beetaaga obubaka obulala ku ngeri embeera gamba nga myaka oba obulamu bwe bizingiramu okuvaako omuntu okufuna akawuka ka HPV ne kookolo.
Baanoonyereza engeri enzirukanya ezimu ez’okwekebera (eziyitibwa enkola z’okusunsula) bwe zaali mu kuvumba akawuka ka HPV n’ebibala.
Era baali baagala okugeraageranya enkola z’okusunsula, ng’ekyokulabirako okukunganya obutaffaali okuva mu lubuto okwekebera obulyo obwonooneka okugeraageranya n’okunoonya ebikomere byokka.
Era baayagala okumanya oba enjawulo wakati w’abakazi, gamba ng’emyaka gyabwe, oba nga balina endwadde endala gamba ng’aka HIV, kyakyusanga omukisa gwabwe okufuna akawuka ka HPV ne kookolo.
Okumanya obubaka buno kuyamba amalwaliro n’amakaaliiko okukozesa enkola z’okusunsula mu ngeri esingayo obulungi.
Abanoonyereza baalaba ebiwandiiko by’abalwadde ku bakyala 214 abaali bakebeddwa era ne bajjanjabwa akawuka ka HPV, ebisansa, ne kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana mu ddwaaliro e Windhoek, Namibia.
Baateekateeka nnyo ku kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana ogw’omutindo ogw’olubereberye, gwe gumu gwe kirwadde kiyinza okujjanjabwa mu buwanguzi era mu ngeri esingako.
Baakuŋŋaanya n’obubaka obukwata ku myaka gya buli mukyala, awamu n’obulamu bwe obwa bulijjo.

Bwe baalondoola ebiwandiiko bino, baazuula nti enkola za okusunsula ez’enjawulo emirundi mingi zaawanga abeebyobulamu amawulire ag’enjawulo, era nga ziyinza okuba nga wa mugaso nnyo nga akawuka ka HPV tekannafuuka kookolo oba oluvannyuma lw’okufuuka kookolo.
Okugeza, kookolo yakwatibwa emirundi mingi nga bakunganya ne bakebera obutaffaali bw’omubiri gw’omwana.
Kyokka, ebiziyiro byandirabika mu kulengera, nga tuyita mu ngeri eyitibwa “okulengera oluvannyuma lw’okufuka akawuka aka acetic acid” (VIA).
Akinnyonnyo kya ngeri eno kwe kuba nti kiyamba abasawo okukizuula obulwadde mangu era nga si kya buseere.
Kuba kikozesa ebikozesebwa eby’obujjanjabi ebyangu ebya bulijjo ebikozesebwa mu kwekebeza abakyala mu buwala, gamba ng’ekikozesebwa eky’ekyuma ekikwata ekibira (speculum).
Era baakizuula nti okukozesa enkola ezitali zimu emirundi mingi kiwa abasawo ebikwata ku kukanula kwa mukazi okufuna kookolo, naddala mu kwekebeza okw’enjawulo.
Okwongera, abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakyala abakulu, naddala abo abalina HIV, be baasobola okufuna kookolo, n’olwekyo okubasunsulanga emirundi mingi kiyinza okuba kikulu nnyo.
Abanoonyereza baagattako nti abakazi batono nnyo be baakebezebwa kookolo ya HPV (nga tebannafuna bisigalira) wadde ng’omukebezewo guliwo.
Okukola bwetyo kiyinza okuba ng’engeri ya muwendo nnyo ey’okuzula endwadde eyo ne mu bwangu.

Mu bujjuvu, bagamba nti ebyava mu kunoonyereza kwabwe byalaga nti waliwo obwetaavu bw’okuteesa enkola y’obujjanjabi mu Namibia okuteekateeka enkola z’okwewala akawuka ka HPV ne kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana mu ngeri esingako, nga bakozesa enkola z’okukebera ez’enjawulo era ez’obulungi okusobola okuzuula endwadde zino mu bwangu.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa bannassaayansi b’omu Namibia n’ab’omu South Africa.
Kinnyonnyola ekigambo mu kw’obulabe bwa HBV/HIV bw’ogeraageranya n’obulabe bwa HBV bokka mu kibinja ky’abantu mu South Africa

Olw’ebiruubirirwa by’ensi yonna eby’okumalawo akawuka ka Hepatitis B (HBV), twatandika okwekenneenya abantu abalina akawuka ka HBV bokka, n’abo abalina akawuka ka HBV/HIV, okwekenneenya omulimu gw’eddagala, n’okukulembera okutereeza obujjanjabi.
Tulaga obubaka obuva mu kwegendereza abantu mu kibinja eky’abantu 115 abakulu abalina obuwuka obw’obuwuka obwa Hepatitis B (CHB), mu ddwaaliro ly’e yunivasite e Cape Town, South Africa.
Okufuna HIV wamu kwali mu bantu 39 (34%).
Twawandiika ebikwata ku balwadde, eby’obujjanjabi n’ebya mu laboretri.

Bw’ogeraageranya n’abo abalina obuwuka bwa HIV, abantu abakulu abalina obuwuka bwa HBV bokka tebaali baasobola kuba nga balina HBeAg (p=0.01), tebaali baasobola kuba nga baweereddwa okukemebwa okukozesa elastography (p<0.0001), era tebaali baasobola kuba nga bakozesa eddagala ly’obuwuka (p<0.0001); baali basobola okuba nga balina HBV viraemia ey’okulabika (p=0.04), era baali basobola okuba nga balina obubonero bw’obulwadde bw’ekibumba omuli thrombocytopaenia eya bukadde/ey’amaanyi (p=0.007), bilirubin ey’ewaggulu (p=0.004), n’ebigero bya APRI eby’ewaggulu (p=0.02).
Ebyokubiri ebya kookolo w’ekibumba byonna byava mu kubulankana kwa HBV.

Obubaka bwaffe bulaga nti abantu abalina akawuka ka HBV bokka bayinza okuba nga bali wansi mu mbeera okusinga abo abalina akawuka ka HIV, nga kino kiraga obutali bwenkanya mu kusindika abantu eri abasawo, okulaba embeera y’obuwuka, n’okujjanjaba.
Abanoonyereza bawa obulagirizi okuyamba okujjanjaba akawuka ka Hepatitis B.

Mu kunoonyereza kwa gye buvuddeko, abanoonyereza baasobola okwoleka engeri okubeera n’obuwuka bwa Hepatitis B (HBV) ne akawuka ka HIV gye kiyinza okuwa omukisa mu bujjanjabi okusinga okubeera n’obuwuka bwa HBV bokka.
Mu bukiika kkono bwa Afirika, obuwuka obwa HBV ne HIV obuwulira ekiseera kiwanvu kizibu kinene.
Abasawo beetaaga okutegeera engeri akawuka kano n’eddagala eryakozesebwa okujjanjaba gye gakwatagana, basobole okutambuza bulungi n’okulabirira abalwadde.
Abanoonyereza baayagala okugerageranya engeri obujjanjabi bwe bukozesebwa ku balwadde abalina HBV bokka, n’abalwadde abalina HBV ne HIV.
Okunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baafuna abalwadde abakulu 115 abalina obuwuka obw’ekibumba ky’omundu ekitaliimu (CHB).
Baafunibwa mu ddwaaliro e Tygerberg, e Cape Town, mu South Africa.
Abawadde abamu baalina akawuka ka HIV (39) ate abalala baalina akawuka ka HBV bokka.
Abanoonyereza baatunuulira ekika, emyaka n’ekikula, era ne bakola ebigezo eby’enjawulo eby’ekisawo n’ebya mu lubuga.

Baalaba nti abalwadde abaalina HBV bokka baali basusse okuba nga tebali ku ddagala ly’obuwuka, nga balaga obubonero obwa bulijjo bw’endwadde y’ekibumba (kubanga HBV ye akawuka akasobola okuleeta endwadde y’ekibumba ey’amaanyi).

Abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga nti abantu abalina HBV bokka baali mu buzibu bw’okulemwa bw’ogeraageranya n’abo abalina HIV ne HBV, kubanga abalwadde abalina akawuka k’ombi baali basobola okufuna eddagala ly’obuwuka lya HIV, eriyamba n’okulwanyisa obuwuka bwa HBV.

Ebibala ku kunoonyereza kuno biraga obukulu bw’enjawulo wakati w’okujjulira, okugoberera, n’enkola z’okuwanga obujjanjabi bw’akaati ka HBV bwe zigeraageranyizibwa n’akaati ka HIV ne HBV nga kazina wamu, ekigenderera abalina akaati ka HIV ne HBV bombi.
Abanoonyereza baasomesa nti tulina okutereeza era tuwe abalwadde abalina HBV bokka omulimu omutebenkevu era omutaliimu.
Obutamanya bw’okunoonyereza kuno bwe bulimu obutono bw’abantu abaakozeseddwa era nga baali ba mu ggwanga limu n’amawuliro gaalyo.
Ebimu, omuli eby’eddwaliro ebisinga obugwanvu, biyinza okwoleka endowooza eyenkanankana bw’egerageranyizibwa n’ebyaazuulwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Okunoonyereza okulala kulina okukolebwa okutuuka ku kutegeera enjawulo ezasangibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Ekitabo kino kyalaze amaanyi g’okukolagana, nga abanoonyereza abakola ku pulojekiti eno bavudde mu South Africa ne mu Bungereza.
Okukozesa abalwadde okuva mu South Africa mu kunoonyereza kuno, kyetaagisa ekimu ku bantu ba Afirika.
Okwongera, okunoonyereza kuno kuyinza okuyamba mu kukola enteekateeka z’obujjanjabi obulungi eri abo abalwadde ba HBV, HIV oba bombi.
Okwekenneenya Obuzibu bw’Obutali bwa Bwongo ku Mirimu gy’Obusuubuzi bw’Abakyala mu Kitundu kya Gavumenti ekya SHIRORO mu Ggwanga lya Niger.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwakebera omulimu gw’obulabe bw’obutakkiriza ku mirimu gy’obusuubuzi gy’abakyala mu kitundu kya Gavumenti ez’ebitundu eky’e Shiroro mu ssaza ly’e Niger, nga kikulembera ku nsonga ez’okutegeka kw’abakyala ku ssente, omulamwa gw’emirimu gy’obusuubuzi egya bulijjo gye bali, n’engeri obulabe bw’obutakkiriza bw’okukwata ku mirimu gyabwe gy’obusuubuzi.

Sampolo y’abakazi 377 yakenenyeddwa, era ekyo kyavuddemu ebiwulire nti abakazi mu Shiroro baagala okukola omulimu nnyo era balina obugagga obw’enjawulo, era bakola omulimu mu bitundu ebitono eby’obuwangwa.

Okunoonyereza okwo era kwalaga nti wadde obutakwatagana bulina omuwendo mubi ku mirimu gy’abakyala egy’okwekulaakulanya mu ngeri y’okufiirwa oba okukendeera kw’ensimbi wakati w’ebintu ebirala, omuwendo gw’abakyala abakola emirimu gy’okwekulaakulanya tegulakanye kukendeera kwa maanyi.

Okunoonyereza kuno kuweesa nti wandibaddewo pulogulaamu ez’olubeerera okuyamba abakyala okufuna era okukozesa obuweereza bw’ensimbi, era n’ebitongole by’okukuuma omutemwa mu bitundu ebyo bisinze okukolebwa era ne bikuumibwa bulungi okutaliisa obutali bwa butebenkevu mu kitundu ekyo ekyonoonyerezebwa.
Abakyala abakola omulimu mu Niger beetaaga obukuumi obusingawo.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakazi abakola obuyinza mu Niger baalina obugagga obw’enjawulo era nga beeyimirirwa mu byensimbi, naye obulamu obutaliiko bukyamu ku bantu abakola obumenyi bw’amateeka buli nsonga.

Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya obutonde n’obutebenkevu bw’abakyala abakolera emirimu mu kitundu kya Gavumenti ekya Shiroro mu ssaza lya Niger, n’engeri ekyo gye kiyinza okukwata ku mirimu gyabwe n’obugagga bwabwe.
Baabuuza abakyala 377 mu kitundu kino ebizibu bye baasanga mu mirimu gyabwe egy’obusuubuzi, obulimba bw’ensimbi n’obulamu obutali butebenkevu.
Baategeeza nti ebitundu 43% eby’abakazi baagamba nti tebaali beesiga basajja ku ssente, ate ebitundu 32% baagamba nti baali balina abantu abalala ababeesiga ku ssente.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti ebitundu 85% eby’abakazi baali bafuna ssente okuva mu mirimu egy’enjawulo, ate batono bokka be baagamba nti baali beesiga musaala.
Ebitundu nga 56% baafuna ensimbi okulimira, ate ebitundu 79% okulimu butunzi.
Abakyala nga omu ku bataano baafuna ensimbi okuyita mu kukola engoye, okussa, okubuuza oba okuwoza.
Abakyala abasinga obungi (91%) baategeeza abanoonyereza nti emirimu gyabwe gyakosebwa olw’okutya okukwatibwa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
Bafiirwa ssente ne bbaabwe olw’ebikwekweto ebyo, oluusi ne kibaviirako okulabirira abaana baabwe bokka.
Abakazi era baagamba nti tebalina busobozi bwa maanyi n’ensimbi za kweyongereza ku mirimu gyabwe.
Abanoonyereza baategeeza nti wadde nga waliwo obuzibu obwo, abakyala ba Nigeria beeyongera okukola bulungi nnyo mu bizinensi zaabwe.
Baagamba nti Shiroro mwalimu abantu b’ebika n’eddiini ezitali zimu, era n’ekyo kyali kirungi ku bulimu.
Okunoonyereza kuno kukakasa ebyazuulibwa by’abanoonyereza abalala abaategeeza nti abakyala tebafuna bulungi mu bulimu olw’okukuuma awaka.
Wabula, abanoonyereza bano bagamba nti okukulaakulana kw’abakyala abakugu mu by’obusuubuzi mu kitundu kino eky’e Niger kikosebwa nnyo olw’obutakwatagana bw’abamenyi b’amateeka n’ababbi.
Abanoonyereza baateesa nti abakwatibwako bonna balina okukwatagana okulwanyisa ebizibu ebiyinza okulemesa okukulaakulana kw’ebyenzige.
Okugeza, abakazi mu Niger basaanidde okufuna obuyambi obw’ensimbi, ettaka n’obuweerwa obw’okwerinda.
Era baateesa nti abakyala abakola bizinensi basobola okukola ggwangaaliro ebiyinza okubayamba okulwanyisa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
Amayengo ga Seleniyamu, Ekikomo ne Zinki mu Lusaayisaayi lwa Maama mu kiseera ky’obuto ateekawo akabenje ak’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka: Okunoonyereza okw’okugerageranya okuva e Malawi
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kwe kuzaala nga olunaku lw’obuzaalibwa tegunnuuddwa wiiki 37.
Okunoonyereza kukoleddwa okwekebejja enkolagana eri wakati w’obungi bw’obusobozi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki mu lusaayisaayi lw’amaama, n’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno okw’okugeraageranya okw’omu njuyi, waaliwo abakyala 181, 90 ku 181 (49.7%) nga baali bazaala mu kiseera, ate 91 ku 181 (50.3%) nga baali bazaala nga tebannaweza.

Omukkati gw’obungi bw’omuwendo gwa seleniyamu mu lusaayisaayi gwali 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, ekikomo gwali 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L era zinki gwali 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L nga emiwendo egikwatagana gya 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L ne 0.59-1.11 mg/L, okusinziira ku bwetaavu.
Ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza biraga nti tewali buzibu bwa seleniyamu, ne zinki; era nga waliwo lusaayisaayi lya kikopa lingi mu kiseera ky’obukyala.
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kwakwatagana n’obungi bw’ekikomo ne zinki mu lusaayisaayi lwa maama.
Amagulu ga zinki, ekikomo, ne seleniyamu agatwalagana n’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka
Abanoonyereza baazuula ebitundu bingi eby’ebiriisa bya seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki mu bakyala abazaala abaana nga tebannaatuuka, naye tebakimanyi oba ebitundu bino bingi biva mu mmere gye balya.
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kubawo nga omukyala azaala nga tannatuuka wiiki 37 ng’ali olubuto.
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kukwatagana n’ebintu ebibi ebivaako obuzibu ku mwana okuva ku bulema okutuuka ku kufa.
Waliwo ensonga nnyingi ezisobola okuleeta okuzaala omwana atannatuuka, naye omulimu gw’ebiriisa bingi ebisangibwa mu mmere ne mu nzirukanya tegumanyiddwa bulungi.
Ebiriisa bino bikulu mu kukula kw’omwana, naye abanoonyereza baagala okumanya ekibawo nga biba bingi nnyo.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baagala okupima obungi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki mu bakyala abazaala abaana nga tannatuuka, oluvannyuma ne bamanye obusobozi bw’okuzaala omwana nga tannatuuka olw’obungi bw’ebiriisa buli kimu ekyanoonyerezebwa.
Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya sampolo z’omusaayi okuva ku bakyala 181 mu bwangu oluvannyuma lw’okubaaza mu malwaliro abiri mu Lilongwe, olukibuga olukalu e Malawi, wakati wa Juuni 2016 ne Maaki 2017.
Baatwala sampolo z’omusaayi ne bazitwala mu kkeberero e Norway gye baaggyaamu lusaayisaayi, ekika kya musaayi omulongoofu, ne bapima obungi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki.
Abakyala nga kati abasukka mu kitundu ekimu ku 181 abaali mu kunoonyereza baazaala abaana nga tebanatuuka, era abanoonyereza baazuula seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki bingi nnyo.

Oluvannyuma ne batereeza ebirowoozo byabwe okutegeera ebintu ebirala bingi gamba ng’emyaka, obulamu obutali bwa buli kiseera, n’ebyo ebibaddewo mu buzaala okusobola okumanya engeri ekiriisa gye kiyinza okuleeta okuzaala omwana atannatuuka.

Baakuteekawo nti obungi bwa seleniyamu ne kikopa tebwalina kye buleeta mu kuba okuzaala omwana atannatuuka, naye obungi bwa zinki bwayongera enkizo y’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka emirundi egisukka mu mukaaga.
Kyokka, obungi bw’ekikomo bwali buli bw’obutakkaanya eri abanoonyereza, olw’emigaso gyabwo egy’obutwa egy’etegeerekeka.

Okuba nga baali abakyala 181 bokka abenyigidde mu kunoonyereza kuno kyaleetera abanoonyereza obutamanyanga bulungi ensobi ezikwata ku mitindo gya seleniyamu egigulumivu, kubanga omuwendo omutuufu gw’abantu abalina okwenyigira gwe 600.
Endya z’abeetabi ez’ennaku zonna tezaanoonyerezebwa okumanya ebiweebwayo ebiyinza okuba eby’ebiriisa ebisatu, era obugabize bw’obuzito n’obuwanvu bw’emibiri gyabwe tebwawandiikibwa.
Gunno gwe kunoonyereza okw’omuwendo gwakyo okusooka okugema engeri seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki gye zikoleramu mu bakyala ab’olubuto mu Malawi.
Afirika erimu emitindo gya waggulu egy’okuzaala abaana abatanatuuka - okusinga 18% nga bwe kiri mu mawanga g’ebuvanjuba 5%, kyeyava abanoonyereza baagala okumanya oba endya erina omulimu.
Eŋŋendo ey’okudda ewuwo, Okubeera mu Kifo Kimu, n’Okwegalamira Ettaka ly’Omusaayi gwa Pancake (Malacochersus tornieri) mu Kenya
Ebisolo birina enneeyisa ya njawulo mu bifo n’obudde ebisobozesa okusigala nga balamu.
Okutegeera engeri ezo kye kintu ekikulu mu kukuumirwa n’okulabirira obulungi, naddala ebitonde ebiri mu kabi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, twagezaako okulaba obusobozi bw’enjagu ya Pancake okuzzaayo awaka singa ekyusiddwa, era twakola n’okunoonyereza ku kubaako ekifo ekimu n’obuwangwa bw’okwekwata ekifo mu bifo byabwe eby’obulamu mu Kitui County, Kenya.

Ebikolwa by’enjagu 39 ezaali zibeera mu nnyingiriri ez’amayinja 12 ezaali ziwawukana mu kifo byanoonyerezebwa okuva mu July 2020 okutuuka mu June 2022 nga mu kunoonyereza kuno mukozeseddwa enkola y’okukolera ku nsolo nga zikozesa reedio, kamera ezikwata ebifaananyi, n’okugezesa ku kibiina kyonna awamu n’okugezesa okutali kwa buli kiseera.

Eŋŋamira kkumi nnya zaasibwako ebyokutambuza amasimu era ne zitwalibwa okuva mu buli kifo kyazo eky’awaka okudda mu binnya ebirala ebitali kye by’awaka era ne byetambula byazo n’empisa byabyo ne bitunulwa.

Okujjawo abakazi babiri bokka abaasobola okwefuga bulungi mu bulimi obw’enjawulo obwali babasindikiddwamu, ensolo endala zonna zaageragerera okudda mu maka gaazo, nga 46.15% ku zo zaasobodde okudda mu bulimi bwazo obwa bulijjo nga zikakasa bulungi, ate 15.38% nazo zaatuukira mu bifo ebirowoozebwa okuba mu bitundu byazo eby’awaka.
Okudda awaka okulungi tekuwavuuna ku bujulizi bw’obukadde obw’amaanyi mu bika.

Okwekenneenya okukwata ku kuba kw’ensolo ez’ekika kya tortoise mu buli kifo kwakiraga nti tewali njawulo ya maanyi wakati w’obuwumbi bw’ensolo ezaaliwo mu kusooka mu buli kifo n’obuwumbi bwazo obusembayo mu nnaku 162 ez’okugezesa (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), era kino kyongera okukakasa nti ensolo zino zikulabirako ebifo byazo.

Ku luuyi olulala, ebifaananyi ebyakubibwa kkamera n’okugezaako okukola okunoonyereza okw’enjawulo byalaga nti ensolo ez’ekika kya Pancake tortoises zikwata ettaka, nga basajja balwanyisa ennyo ettaka lyabwe okuva ku basajja abalala abalaba.
Enjagu ezibulwa eza pancake zirina obusobozi obw’amaanyi obw’okudda awaka.
Abanoonyereza baafunye ekintu ekyewuunyisa nga banoonyereza ku mpisa y’enjagu ez’omu buvanjuba bwa Afrika (Malacochersus tornieri): ensolo zino zisobola okudda eka oluvannyuma lw’okutwalibwa ebbanga.
Okutegeera engeri gye bakola bwe batyo n’ensonga lwaki bakikola kiyinza okuba ekikulu mu kukuuma ebyewalula bino eby’ekitalo.
Engeri y’okunoonya awaka ensolo zino ez’enjagu eziraga eyitibwa “okudda awaka”, era n’ensolo endala nnyingi zisobola okukikola.
Okusobola okuddayo mu bifo ebimu kiyamba ensolo okuddayo ku mmere, ku bannaabwe, ne ku kifo eky’okubeeramu, ekyo ne kyongera omukisa gwazo okuguma n’okuzaala.

Wadde ng’okudda eka kw’ebisolo kuwumulwa mu ntungo n’amazzi, abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti tukyamanyi kitono nnyo ku kudda eka kw’enjagu (ebisolo eby’oku nsi ebigeraageranyizibwa ku ntungo).
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera ebisingawo ku mpisa y’ensolo ez’ekika kya pancake tortoise mu maka gaazo e Kenya mu bitundu eby’amabala.
Baakolera ku nsolo nga zivaayo, nga zirya, era ne bwe zaagendanga okuwummula mu bulimba oba mu buwaŋŋoŋo bw’amayinja.
Abanoonyereza beetegereza ebika by’enjoka za pancake okumala ebbanga lya myaka kumpi ebiri, era ne bassaako kamera okuwandiika vidiyo y’ensolo zino nga tebabalaba.
Era baasikirako obutambi obw’amasannyalaze ku nsolo ez’enkalu 14.
Gano ge bitonde obutono ebiyamba abanoonyereza okulondoola entambula y’ensolo, n’okulaba awatambulira emisana n’ekiro.
Awo abanoonyereza ne basengula ebiwato ebimu ebyo ebyabadde bikwatibwako mu kitundu ekiggya, baleme okuyiga bulungi.
Kyokka, ekyewuunyisa abanoonyereza, bibinja bibiri ku by’enjagu byatandika okudda mu bitundu byabyo eby’edda, wakati wa kilometeri emu ne 2.5 okuva we baali basudduse.
Lwaki abanoonyereza baasalawo okugezaako okusengula ensolo ezingi okuva mu maka gaazo, okulaba obanga zandiraga empisa efaanana ey’okudda eka.

Ekintu ekikwata ku mutima, kitegeeza nti obukadde bw’ensolo zino ez’amasasi obusembayo bwazuulibwa nga buzzeeyo mu buli bw’ebisumuluzo bye byali bibaddemu nga tebinnatandikibwa, emirundi mingi nga bitambula olugendo oluwera emitala 1.5 okutuuka eyo.
Ate abalala 15% baasobola okudda mu kitundu, naye tebasobola kuzuula bulimba gye baali batwaliddwa.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti obuwuka obwa njawulo businga okuba n’obungi bw’enjagu ezisulamu obulingana, ekyo ne kiraga nti enjagu zikolera mu bifo bimu okuwummula.
Okuva mu kkamera kwatulaga nti enkoko ennume zaali n’ettaka lyazo, ekitegeeza nti zaalwana ennume endala ezali zeeyongera okuyingira ettaka lyazo oba olulimi.

Abanoonyereza bagamba nti guno gwe mulundi gwasooka okulaba empisa y’okudda mu maka gaayo ku bikoko bya pancake tortoises, era nti ebyo bye baazuula biraga nti ensolo zino zikulaakulana okubeera n’okwesiima mu bifo bimu buli lwe zisobola.
Okunoonyereza kwabwe tekuwanika bulungi ng’enjagu zino zezuula engeri gy’ezzeewo, n’olwekyo okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu maaso kulina okussa essira ku kutegeera ensonga eno ekikulu.
Olw’okuba ensolo oluusi zibeerawetaagisa okusazibwa mu bitundu bipya olw’okukuuma, obubaka buno buyamba abakuuma ensolo okukuuma ebisolo eby’ennyonyi mu maka gaabwe agakya.
Okunoonyereza kwakolerwa mu mukwano wakati wa bannassaayansi okuva mu Kenya ne China, era kwongereza ku kumanya kwaffe okukwata ku ndabika y’okudda mu maka gaayo mu bikoko n’ebisolo ebirala.
Emirimu gy’eddagala mu musaayi ogw’omubiri ogwa Rifampicin ey’omugugu omungi eyawangulwa mu kamwa ne eyawangulwa mu mituba mu balwadde abalina akafuba akagugubira mu bwongo:
Okugezesa okw’akawuka okwalabiraawodwa
Obungi bw’eddagala lya rifampisin eryawangulwa mu mituba gisobola okwongera ku bulungi bw’obujjanjabi bw’akafuluba ak’omu bwongo naye tekikolwa mu mawanga agalina obulwadde obwo obungi.

Twategeeza nti obungi bw’eddagala lya rifampicin mu musaayi bwandyeetera okufanana wakati w’okunywa eddagala mu kamwa ka 35 mg/kg ya buzito bw’omubiri n’okuyongeza eddagala mu mitogo gya 20 mg/kg, ekintu ekyategeerezebwa okukozesebwa mu kugeza ku buwanguzi bw’eddagala mu kulwanyisa akafuba akagwira ubwonjo.
Twakola okunoonyereza okw’okwesomesa okw’ebibinja ebikwatiriganya nga kwekaliriza mu kunoonyereza okw’ekikugu ku bujjanjabi obw’amaanyi obw’eddagala eritta obuwuka olw’akafafa k’omu bwongo.
Abantu abalina akawuka ka HIV abalina akafuba akwata ku bwongo baafunibwa mu malwaliro ga South Africa era ne bassibwa mu bibiina bisatu eby’enjawulo eby’omuwendo gw’eddagala lya rifampicin:
Eky’omugaso (okuwanga mu kamwa 10 mg/kg), ekya waggulu (okuwanga mu kamwa 35 mg/kg), n’ekya mu mittaano (20 mg/kg).
Okwekebejja kwa pharmacokinetic okw’amaanyi kwaakolebwa ku lunaku olw’okusatu.
Obubaka bwannyonnyolwa nga tukozesa enneekaliriza etali ya compartments, era ebibuuzo byageraageranyizibwa na geometric mean ratios (GMRs).
Abantu 46 baatwalibwa ku mugezo gw’eddagala (omuwendo ogwa bulijjo, n = 17; omuwendo omungi ogw’okuwanga mu kamwa, n = 15; okuwanga mu mitogo, n = 14).
Omuwendo gwa CD4 ogusinga obungi gwali 130 cells/mm3 (obusookerwako [IQR], 66 okutuuka ku 253 cells/mm3).

Amatobo g’omukkati g’ekibalo g’ekitundu ekisangibwa wansi w’omuwendo gw’eddagala mu mubiri mu kiseera (AUC0–24) ga rifampicin gaali 42.9mg · h/ml (obukakafu bwa 95% [CI], 24.5 okutuuka ku 75.0mg ·h/ml) ku bungi obwa bulijjo, 295.2mg · h/ml (obukakafu bwa 95% [CI], 189.9 okutuuka ku 458.8mg · h/ml) ku bungi obusinga obwa mu kanwa, ne 206.5mg · h/ml (obukakafu bwa 95% [CI], 154.6 okutuuka ku 275.8mg · h/ml) ku bungi obw’okugemesa mu mitogo.

Obuwuka bwa rifampicin AUC0–24 GMR bwali 1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 okutuuka ku 2.21) ate omugaso gw’eddagala mu lusaayisaayi (Cmax) GMR n’eba 0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 okutuuka ku 1.23) mu kuwanga eddagala mu ngeri ya waggulu ng’ogeraageranya n’okuliwa mu mitogo.

Obungi bw’eddagala lya rifampicin mu musaayi okuva ku ssaawa 0 okutuuka ku ssaawa 24 bwali busingawo oluvannyuma lw’okunywa eddagala erya 35-mg/kg okusinga okufuna eddagala nga liwumulwa mu mituba egy’omubiri ku 20-mg/kg mu nnaku ezisooka ez’okuwangaza akafuba (TB).
Ebyazuulibwa bino biwagira okugabulwa kw’eddagala lya rifampicin mu kamwa mu gezesa g’omu maaso ag’obulwadde bwa meningitis bwa tuberculous.
Eddagala ery’omuwendo omwanguwa liyinza okugezesebwa ku balwadde ba HIV abalina akawuka ka TB meningitis.
Abanoonyereza bakakasizza nti kyetaagisa okutandika okukebera oba obuwuka obw’eddagala erya rifampicin obw’amaanyi buyinza okuwonya abalwadde ba HIV abalina akafuba k’omu bwongo.
Abalwadde ba HIV abasukka mu 3 ku buli 5 era abafuna akawuka ka TB akawuka akalwanyi akamenyaamenya akabonero akalwanyi ka meningitis, bafa olw’obulwadde buno obulumba enkola y’amawulire.
Abawona batera okusigala nga balina omulimu gw’amaanyi ogwonooneka mu buntu bw’amaanyi ag’omubiri era n’amaanyi ag’omukulu agava mu bwongo.
Kino kisobola okukosa embeera zaabwe n’okutambula kwabwe.
Abamu ku balwadde bafuna okwesika oba obukwaayi, oba ebitundu by’amaaso oba omubiri gwabwe ne bifuuka buleme.
Rifampicin, eddagala ery’amaanyi ery’obujjanjabi ery’akafuba, litera okuweebwa nga kapisuli okugezaako okuzikiriza akawuka akaleeta akafuba k’omu bwongo.
Abalwadde abalwadde nnyo batera okukiraba nga kizibu okumira amapipi.
Rifampicin era esobola okuweebwayo mu mittaano (mu mitogo) nga ya muzigo.
Oluvannyuma, empiso etteekwa mu misuwa gy’omulwadde, amazzi gabireme okuyingira mu mubiri.
Tekinnakolebwa kugeza konna okumanya engeri omubiri gw’omulwadde gye gutwala eddagala lino nga enkola eno ekozesebwa.
Obujjanjabi bw’eccupa buwetaaga ebintu bingi, okubeera mu malwaliro n’omukozi w’obulamu abategefu era amanyi okuyingiza akakondo k’eccupa mu ngeri etuufu.
N’olwekyo si kya kutegeerezebwa nti kiba kyetaagisa mu bitundu ebitalina bulungi bikozesebwa mu nsi.
Abasawo bamanyi bulungi nti rifampicin teyeyongera bulungi mu mubiri mu buwaaya bw’otwe, omugongo n’omutwe, gye guli obuwuka bwe buyinza okwekuuma.
Nga bwe kiri, wetaaga obungi bw’eddagala okusobola okutta obuwuka bwonna mu mubiri gw’omulwadde.
Kyokka, abanoonyereza tebaali bakakasa muwendo gwa ddozi eyandibadde ekola era nga teerina bulabe.

Abanoonyereza okuva mu South Africa ne United Kingdom kyebava baagala okumanya, nga bakozesa abalwadde batono, oba nga kya buteefu okuwa eddagala lya rifampicin mu bunene obw’enjawulo oba nga liweebwayo mu mpya oba mu mutwe, n’engeri emitiri gyabwe gye gikiteekako buli kika.
Kino kikulu okukimanya nga abanoonyereza abalala tebannaba kutandika ku gezi ezinene, oba okukebera, mwe baateekateeka okuwa abalwadde bangi ennyo omuwendo gw’eddagala lya rifampicin.
Omu ku ngeri ssatu ez’okujjanjaba akafuba nga mukozesebwa eddagala eriyitibwa rifampicin, yagabibwa abalwadde 46 abalina akawuka ka HIV okuva mu South Africa abalina akafuba akwata ku bwongo.
Okusooka kwali kwekulakulanya eddagala erisukka mu mubiri ery’ebikombolero ebiweebwa abalwadde kati, nga buli kilogramu omuwendo gwa rifampicin gwe balina okuweebwa guli 10mg.
Ekibinja ekirala kyafuna obujjanjabi obw’obuwungaanyi obw’amakapuuli ag’emigero 35 ku kilo emu ey’omubiri gw’omulwadde.
Ekibinja ekisatu baakiwa eddagala mu mittaano, nga buli muntu afuna emiligiramu 20 ku buli kilo y’omubiri gwe.
Sampolo z’omusaayi zaggyibwa ku balwadde oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ssatu.
N’oluvannyuma abanoonyereza baapima obungi bwa rifampisin obwali mu plasma ya musaayi gwabwe (ekitundu ekisikiriza mu musaayi).
Rifampicin nyingi ezasangibwa mu mibiri gy’abalwadde abaafuna obujjanjabi obw’obuwuka obw’amaanyi okusinga abo abaafuna obujjanjabi obw’omu mituba gy’omusaayi oba obujjanjabi obwa bulijjo.
Obungi bw’eddagala mu pulazuma y’omusaayi bwali bumu ku muwendo omwanguwa ne ku bujjanjabi obw’omu mittaano.
Emikwano gino gyali gya waggulu okusinga bwe baali bafuna buli muntu omuwendo gwa bulijjo.
Okusinziira ku bannoonyereza, kino kiraga nti embeera y’obulamu bw’abalwadde abalwadde akawuka ka meningitis aka tuberculosis esobola okutereezebwa singa bafuna obungi bw’eddagala lya rifampicin.
Tekikulu nti bakifuna nga bipuli oba nga bakifunira mu mituba gy’omusaayi - ekikulu kwe kufuna doozi eziwera, kubanga omubiri gwaabwe gujja kusobola okukuŋŋaanya obungi bw’eddagala.
Ebyazuulibwa bino bikwata ku byazuulibwa mu geesiga ezakolebwa mu Uganda ne mu Indonesia.

Ekyokulabirako, geesiga ez’obutono bbiri ezaakolebwa mu Indonesia biraga nti obulamu bw’abalwadde bangi busobola okutaasibwa singa bawa edosi ey’omuwendo gwa rifampicin, oba nga bagiwanywa oba nga bagiwaddibwa.
Kyokka, eky’ennaku, abanoonyereza balabula nti abantu abatonotono be bazeeyambisa mu kunoonyereza kuno okusinga bwe baali balongoosezza, era nga kino kiyinza okwonoona bye baazuula.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa mu South Africa.
Kino kiwagira enteekateeka y’okukola okugezesa okulaba oba kiba kya mugaso okuwa abalwadde ba HIV abalina akafuba k’omu bwongo amayengo mangi ga rifampicin.
Kisuubirwa nti obujjanjabi obwo bujja kutaasa obulamu bw’abantu bangi mu Afirika ne mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala ewali obulwadde bw’obwongo obw’akafafa kye kizibu kinene.
Okukozesa omugongo n’ebyandayanda awamu kisobola okutereeza ettaka ery’omu ddwaliro ery’oku lubalama olwonooneka nnyo?
Okusereba kw’obugimu bw’ettaka kizibu kinene eri okulimira mu Afirika eri wansi w’eddungu Sahara.
Okuvaayo kw’ebyandayanda n’ebigimusa eby’omutaka ku bugobero bw’ettaka kyawandiikiddwa abawandiisi bangi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, waliwo okugerageranya okwakolebwa mu lubboogo okumala ennaku 30 nga bakozesa sampolo 120 g buli emu ey’ettaka lya Haplic acrisol erongebwaako ebyandayanda eby’ekikunka kya kasooli (cbio), ebyandayanda eby’omusulo gw’omubale (rbio), ebyandayanda eby’obusuku bw’omugogo (coco300 ne coco700) oba omugongo gw’ebinyonyi (compost); ne ebyandayanda eby’omusulo gw’omubale ebyakolebwa wamu (rcocomp) oba ebyandayanda eby’ekikunka kya kasooli ebyakolebwa wamu (cococomp) ku mitindo gya 1% w/w ekyongezebwa: ettaka, okusinziira ku buli kimu.

Ebyokulongoosa ebirala mu kunoonyereza kuno byali byakubaganya omugongo gw’ebinyonyi ne ebyandayanda ebya corn cob oba ebya rice husk (1% omugongo + 1% ebyandayanda: 1% ettaka w/w), okwekenneenya engeri bye bikolela ku kufuluma kwa kaboni mu ttaka, obuwufu bw’ettaka; kaboni w’obulamu obutono mu ttaka; obusobozi bw’okukyuusa cation; kaboni yonna eya bulimu, nayitrogeni yonna n’obungi bwa nayitrogeni esoboka.
Ebyandayanda n’ekigimusa ebyakozesebwa byokka oba awamu, n’ebyandayanda ebyagimusizzibwa byayongera ku pH y’ettaka obuwumbo 0.28–2.29 ogw’obuwumbo bwa pH okusinga ettaka eryalekebwa nga bwe liri.

Obuwuka obw’omutwe okuva mu komposito y’ekika kyokka oba komposito ey’amaganda g’omubazzi, oba ebyandayanda eby’ekikunka kya kasooli oba ebyandayanda ebyagattibwa ne komposito byali by’amaanyi okusinga ebyo ebitaliiko kyakyongeza, ebyali bifaana n’ebyo ebyava mu byandayanda byokka.
TOC mu mutunzi gw’omuddo gwokka n’emikutu egy’ebyandayanda bya kasooli n’omutunzi gw’omuddo gye yali gy’ekisobyo, byali byeyongedde ku bitundu 37% ne 117% okusinga ku kya muwendo.
Okukozesa wamu ebyandayanda eby’omusulo gw’omuyembe n’ekigimusa kyongera ku MBC ku bitundu 132%, ate okukozesa ekigimusa kyokka kyongera ku MBC ku bitundu 247%, okutwaliza awamu ne mu kigezo.

Wano, okunoonyereza kulaze nti okuteekawo omukutu oba okukozesa wamu omukutu n’ebyandayanda, oba ebyandayanda ebyakutuse, byongera obungi bw’ebintu ebirungi mu ttaka gamba nga pH ya ttaka ne MBC, era bikulaakulanya okunyweza kaboni mu ttaka okuyitira mu kwongera TOC n’okukendeeza ku kubuze kwa kaboni mu ttaka okuyitira mu basal respiration.
Ebyandayanda n’obusa bituuma ettaka okuba eddungi eri ebibala.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwanoonyereza engeri ebyandayanda, ebyo ebya bulimu, eby’obugimu, era eby’omugugu, gye biyinza okukozesebwa okwongera ku mutindo gw’ettaka mu bitundu bya Afirika ebiri wansi w’eddungu Sahara.
Okunoonyereza kwalaga nti ebyandayanda byongera obungi bw’ettaka mu ngeri y’emu ng’enkola endala ez’ebbeeyi nnyingi era ezitaliwo bulungi.
Ekimu ku bizibu eby’enjawulo ebikaluubiriza omulimo gw’obulimi mu Afirika eri wansi w’eddungu Sahara kwe kuseebuwa kw’obugimu bw’ettaka.
Ettaka eddungi lingaleeta amakungula amalungi, era ekyo kirina okukendeeza ku bwavu mu byalo n’okuddawo ku nsonga y’okwonooneka kw’obugagga bw’obutonde.
Okunoonyereza kulaze nti ebyandayanda, ebyo ebya bulimu, eby’obugimu obw’amaanyi, era ebirimu kaboni, bisobola okukozesebwa okwongera obugimu bw’ettaka.
Ebyandayanda bye bintu ebiva mu kwokya ebintu eby’omubiri, oba eby’omukisa, nga tewali musana oba musana muto.
Ebyandayanda biraga nti byongera obungi bw’ettaka, byongera amazzi n’omukka, era ne bizuukusa obutonde bw’obulamu mu ttaka.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwakebera omulimu gw’ebyandayanda n’omukka ku mutindo gw’ettaka nga bakozesa ebintu eby’okulabirako gamba nga okuwunya kw’ettaka, pH y’ettaka, obuwanguzi bw’obuwuka obutono, obungi bw’ekaboni, n’obungi bw’omugavu oguliwo.

Abanoonyereza baakola ebyandayanda ebya kasooli, eby’ekikolo ky’ekikajjo, n’ebya lukusa lwa kalisi, nga bakozesa enkola eyitibwa pyrolysis, eya kwoleka ebintu eby’obutonde mu bbugumu obuli wansi wa 450 °C mu kikozeso ekyakolebwa mu ggwanga.
Abanoonyereza baakola ebyandayanda ebiva mu lukwata lw’ekikookoli, nga bakozesa enkola eyitibwa pyrolysis ku bbugumu bwa 300 °C ne 700 °C.
Awo abanoonyereza ne bassa sampolo z’ettaka ezivangiddwaamu ebyandayanda mu kibbo okumala ennaku 30.

Buli sampolo mwaliyo ettaka eryategekebwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo eryayitibwa Haplic acrisol, eryavangiddwaamu ebyandayanda ebyakolebwa okuva mu bikoola bya kasooli, ebibala bya layisi oba ebibala bya kookonati, ne komposito y’emmeeza z’enkoko.
Sampolo endala zaali zikubamu ekitundu ky’ettaka n’omutta gwa nnyonyi, awamu n’ebyandayanda ebya rice husk, n’ebyandayanda ebya corn cob, okusinziira ku buli kimu.
Buli sampolo yalina 1% y’ekikomposito, 1% ya buli ebyandayanda, baleme okwekenneenya omulimu gw’ekibululo kyonna ku mutindo gw’ettaka.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti okweyongerayo kw’ebyandayanda n’ekigimusa mu ttaka, oba nga bikolebwa kye kimu oba nga bikolebwa awamu, kyongera muwendo gwa pH gw’ettaka okuva ku 0.28–2.29 ebitundu bya pH, nga bageraageranya n’ettaka eritaliimu kigimusa.
Okweyongera kwa pH kitegeeza nti ettaka lyakendeera okwonooneka.

Okunoonyereza kwalaga nti omuwendo omutono ogw’omukka gwa kaboni ogwava mu ttaka, oba okulongoosa okusookerwako, kweyongera singa omugimusa gwokka gweyongerwako, oba singa omugimusa gwakwatibwa wamu n’ebisusunku bya rice, oba ebyandayanda ebya corn cob oba ebyandayanda ebyakwatibwa wamu.

Sampolo z’ettaka zaalaga okweyongera kw’obungi bw’ekirungo kya kaboni mu buzima obw’omunda bwa 37% bwe baakozesa omugongo gwokka, era okweyongera kwa 117% bwe baasakaanya ebyandayanda ebiva mu bikondo bya kasooli ne mugongo.

Obungi bw’ebikolwa by’obulamu obutono bwayongezeka ku bitundu 132% gye waliwo oluvanyuma lw’okuvangulwa kw’ettaka n’ekigimusa n’ebyandayanda eby’omusoro gw’omuyembe, nga bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’okuyongera kwa bitundu 247% mu sampolo z’ettaka ezaalina ekigimusa kyokka.
Ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza kuno biraga nti kisoboka okukendeeza obuzito bw’ettaka nga okozesa ebyandayanda, ebisoboka okufuna bulungi era nga tebiva ku bwerere.
Kino ky’enjawulo ku ngeri endala ey’okuteeka akalimo mu ttaka, ekintu ekigula nnyo era ekitaliwo mu bungi eri abalimi abato mu bitundu by’ebuvanjuba bwa Afirika.
Obutambi bw’Fayibulini obutaddamu Kutegeerekeka mu Bulwadde bw’Ennyingo n’Enkola ya Bwo ku Busibage, Okulungula Omubiri n’Okukakkana kw’Omusaayi
Obulabe bw’ebizibu by’omutima mu balwadde ba RA bweyongera mu buwanguzi olw’okulungula omubiri okw’omu mubiri gwonna.
Obuwuka bw’okukosebwa kwa citrullination ekuŋŋaana n’obutaffaali obulamu ku nsonga n’obusobozi bw’okukosa omusaayi gwa fayibulini(ojini) tebumanyiddwa.

N’olwekyo, twageraageranya ebiragiro eby’obukolerera bw’ebitundu eby’omusaayi, okulungula omubiri, okukakkana kw’omusaayi, n’engeri fayibulini gye yeesiikirizaamu mu balwadde ba RA n’abo abalungi, ne tusekerera enkolagana wakati w’ebiragiro.
Sampolo z’omusaayi zaggyibwa ku balwadde ba RA 30 n’abantu abalamu obulungi 25 abalinga mu myaka n’obukyala.
Amagimu ga SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 ne VCAM-1 gaapimibwa ngaakozesebwa enkola ya sandwich immunoassay.
Okukakkana kw’omusaayi ogw’omubiri gwonna kwakeberwa nga tuyita mu Thromboelastography.
Obutambi bw’omuwendo gwa fayibulini n’ebikula by’obuguwa byakeberedwa nga bakozesa ekyuma ekizimbulukusa.
Okukkenga n’okumanya obungi bwa citrullination mu fayibulini ezikolebwa kwakolebwa nga tukozesa Citrulline monoclonal antibody eyalagibwa omusana n’okukozesa Confocal Microscopy.
Ebigero bya SAA, CRP ne ICAM-1 byali bya waggulu nnyo mu balwadde ba RA okusinga abalala.
Ebipimo bya TEG ebiragira okutandika kw’okukoma (R ne K), obuwanguzi bw’okukoma kwa fayibulini (α-Angle), n’ekiseera eky’okutuuka ku buwanguzi bw’okukoma (TMRTG) byali bitono mu balwadde ba RA.
Ebiramulirwako ebikwata ku buvuvu bw’omusaayi ogukakkana (MA, MRTG, TGG) tebyali na njawulo ya maanyi wakati wa abo abalina RA n’abo abatalina.

Okukolera ku mutetenkanyirizo gw’emigabanyo gy’ebivuddemu kwakiraga akakwate akamaanyi wakati w’ebintu ebyoleka obulwadde obw’amaanyi (CRP, SAA) n’ebintu ebyoleka obukolerera bw’omubiri okusinga ebibonero ebyoleka obukolerera bw’ebitundu eby’omu musaayi.

Okunoonyereza okw’amamicropskoopi kulaze obutambi obw’amaanyi obw’ensimbi za fayibulini ezikaluubirira mu balwadde ba RA okusinga abalala [median (interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm okusinziira ku bwebalamu, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7).
Okukizuula bitundu bingi ebya citrullinated mu by’ekikuta kya fayibulini mu balwadde ba RA, ekyali kitono mu sampolo z’abantu abatalina bulwadde (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Abalwadde abalina obulwadde bwa RA obw’omukka balaga engeri y’okukwata kwa musaayi eyenjawulo ku ebyo ebiboneka mu bulwadde obulala obw’obutonde.

Okukyusa kwekikula kya puloteyini okuva mu citrullination ekyekuusa ku butabagano bw’omubiri olw’okulwanyisa obutaffaali obulamu, kiyinza okubaako omulimu mu kutegeka ekikula kya fayibulini n’obusobozi bw’okuleetawo akatyabaga akawaggulu ak’okufuna obuwuka mu balwadde ba RA.
Okwekwata kw’omusaayi mu balwadde ba mawanga kuyinza okunnyonnyola akatyabaga kaabwe akawaggulu okufuna okulwala kw’omutima, oba okuwanguka.
Okunoonyereza okupya ku bulwadde bw’ennyingo kuwadde okutegeera okusinga obulungi okukwata ku kukwata wakati w’obulwadde buno n’okweyongera kw’akatyabaga k’obulwadde bw’omutima.
Obulwadde bw’ennyingo (RA) bulwadde obulumiriza era obunafuya obw’obusibage, obukwata ku okulungula omubiri mu nnyingo ne mu mubiri gwonna.
Okuva edda, abayizi ba science bamanyi nti abalwadde balina omugaso gwa 50% ogw’okufuna obulwadde bw’omutima (CVD) – gamba nga okuwanguka kw’omusaayi oba okuwanguka kw’omutima.
Kintu ekikulu mu bulabe obwo kwe kuba nti okulungula omubiri kukwata ku nkola y’okwekwata kw’omusaayi.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonyereza enkolagana eno, okukizuula ddala lwaki ekirwadde kya RA kyongera ku buzibu bw’endwadde y’omutima.
Nga kyennyini bwe kiri, abanoonyereza baakebera engeri okulungula omubiri n’enkyukakyuka ez’ekikula gye zikosaamu puloteyini ez’enjawulo ezitwala ku kuzimba omusaayi, eziyitibwa fayibulini.

Puloteyini zino ziba nga ziri mu mizingo emimanyiro egikola omuzingo ogw’enjawulo ogw’omusaayi ogukoma, n’olwekyo enkyukakyuka yonna ku fayibulini zennyini eyinza okuba n’obuzibu ku nkola yonna ey’okukoma kw’omusaayi.
Abanoonyereza baageraageranya sampolo z’omusaayi z’abalwadde ba RA ku sampolo okuva ku bantu abalamu.

Mu buli kifo, abanoonyereza baali banoonya “obubonero” mu musaayi obulaga okulungula omubiri, awamu n’enkyukakyuka eza buli kifo mu nkola ya bulijjo ey’okukakkalabya omusaayi eyandiwonyezza obungi bw’obulabe bwa CVD.
Ebibbo byokka byaakeberwa n’omukutu ogwa mayikulosokopi, okukizuula enkyukakyuka zonna mu nteekateeka ya puloteyini ezikwata omusaayi.

Abanoonyereza baalaba nti obugobe okuva ku balwadde ba RA bwabumbulukuka mangu okusinga obw’abantu abalamu, era nti emigwa gya puloteyini gye byali bikoleddwaako gyali gya buwufu nnyo okusinga fayibulini eza bulijjo.
Waaliwo n’enkyukakyuka mu asidi akola puloteyini ezikola fayibulini, ezaaviirako okutambuza obuyambi bw’omubiri okulwanyisa endwadde, nga kino kireetawo okulungula omubiri okweyongera.
Abanoonyereza abalala baalabye enkyukakyuka mu kitone kya amino acid kya fayibulini mu bbugumu bw’abalwadde ba RA, naye lino lye lumu lwaasooka abanoonyereza okulaba omugezo gumu mu musaayi.

Bwe bigattibwa n’enkyukakyuka endala ezaalaba mu musaayi okwekwata, bye baazuula biyinza okuyamba bannassaayansi okutegeera bulungi enkolagana wakati wa RA ne CVD, n’engeri y’okukizuula obubonero bw’endwadde zino mu buto.
Wadde ebyavaamu eby’okusooka byawera bulungi, kyetaagisa okulowooza nti sampolo ey’okunoonyereza yali ntono mu ngeri.

Abanoonyereza era baategeeza nti enkola gye baakozesa okuzuula enkyukakyuka z’aminoo asiidi mu puloteyini yandisobodde n’okufuna ebibala okuva ku bintu ebitaliiko mukago, ekyoleka nti okukebera okw’enjawulo okweteekateeka fayibulini kujja kuba kyetaagibwa okukakasa ebibala mu biseera eby’omu maaso.

Ekiseera nga kiyiseewo, okutegeera enkolagana enzibu wakati wa RA n’akatyabaga akawaggulu ak’okufuna obulwadde bw’omutima kiyinza okutumbula ebibala ku balwadde ba RA nga bwe tujja okumanya okwekenneenya n’okujjanjaba obulwadde buno obulungi.
Abanoonyereza okuva mu South Africa, Denmark ne Bungereza baali mu kunoonyereza kuno, okwali kusasulwa  olukiiko lw’okunoonyereza ku by’obujjanjabi mu South Africa.
Enteebereza z’embeera y’obudde eziweebwa ku nnyanja eri abakozesa ennyanja – endowooza, okukozesebwa kwazo n’okukwatibwa kwazo.

Okunoonyereza kuno kugezaako okukola ku nsonga y’obutakkaanya wakati wa ssaayansi n’abantu bonna, nga kye kifo eky’obutakkaanya mu kutwala n’okwetaaga amawulire, ekintu ekimanyiddwa nga ‘ebbanga ly’okukozesa’.
Mu mbeera eno, tukola ku bukulu bw’obubaka obukwata ku mbeera y’obudde mu nyanja (metocean) nga bwe bwetegerezebwa abakozesa mu mawanga abiri ag’obukiikaddyo bw’ensi:
South Afirika ne New Zealand.
Wano, ekigendererwa si ku kutunuulira byokka endowooza, okukozesa n’okukwatirako enteebereza z’embeera y’obudde eziyitiridde, wabula kutandika ku kutegeera enteebereza z’embeera y’obudde eza bulijjo.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa nga kukozesa okunoonyereza, okwakolebwa okwetooloola ebibuuzo by’okunoonyereza bisatu.

Ebibuuzo by’okunoonyereza byakwata ku nsonga okuva ku ngeri ebyuma eby’okuteebereza ebikozesebwamu, obuzima n’obutayinza kubaako ku buli kiseera, okukozesebwa kwabyo, enkisa y’ekitongole, n’obutakkaanya obukwata ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde (okutwala ng’ekyokulabirako).
Ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano byagabanirizibwa okutuuka ku bakozesa bonna, ab’obuwangwa n’ab’obusuubuzi.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwesomesa ku kutegeera embeera z’okulonda eziyinza okubaako omuwendo gw’enjawulo ku byetaago by’amawulire by’abantu abakozesa ennyanja eya ku lubalama.

Okunoonyereza okw’engeri y’okutegeera kw’abantu bonna (CCA) kwakozesebwa okunoonyereza okutegeera okugattiddwaamu n’enjawulo mu ndowooza mu kibiina kyonna eky’abo abaabuuziddwa, awamu n’ebibiina eby’enjawulo n’ebya mawanga.
Twalabye enkwatagana eya mitindo egy’enjawulo mu kibiina kyonna (abantu abava mu mawanga gonna n’ebitundu byonna nga bikuŋŋaanye) nga bigeraagerannyizibwa n’ebibiina ebitono eby’abakozesa.
Abeetabi bonna awamu baalaga okukkirizigana kwa buwanguzi mu nsonga ezaaliwo, naye nga waliwo enjawulo mu ndaba mu buli ggwanga, ekiraga nti waliwo obuwangwa obutono obw’enjawulo.

Bwe twakola okwekenneenya ku bitundu by’eggwanga n’ebitundu by’emirimu egy’enjawulo, twalaba okukkirizigana okw’amaanyi mu bantu abakozesa mu South Africa, nga bakkirizigana nnyo ka babe nga bali mu mirimu ki.
Abakozesa ab'obulunzi ba New Zealand be baali baakakkana nnyo n'ebibinja ebirala byonna.
Tukubaganya ebirowoozo ku bintu ebikulu ebiva mu byawandiikibwa byaffe ku bintu ebikulu mu kwakula kw’obuweereza era n’okukola enteebereza ennungi.
Ebintu ebisinga obukulu mu biteebereza bya sayansi mu biseera ebijja nabyo bitwalibwa mu bujjuvu, nga tulowooza ku bintu ebiyinza okuva mu nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Tukubira nga tuwaayo oluyimba olufaananako olugero okwoleka enkolagana ey’amaanyi wakati w’okukola wamu okukola ebintu eby’okubikkula n’obutuukirivu/obuyonjo bw’ensimbi.
Abantu ba South Afirika, n’aba New Zealand beesiga ebiteeberezo by’obudde ku nnyanja.

Abantu ba South Afirika n’aba New Zealand abakolera era abeera mu bitundu ebyetoolodde ennyanja beesigama ku buweereza bw’amawulire g’embeera y’obudde abulungi okukozesa, era obuwa ebiteeberezo eby’amazima buli kiseera.
Obuweereza bw’okuteebereza obudde bw’eggwanga n’ebitongole by’obusuubuzi ebitali bimu eby’oku ‘internet’ biwa ebiteeberezebwa ku ngeri obudde bwe buliba.
Baafuba okubeera abatuufu era abawanguzi mu ngeri yonna.
Omulimu omunene nnyo ogw’ensikirani n’okuteesa okw’ensikirani gukolebwa mu biteeberezo ng’ebyo.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baasalawo okutunuulira engeri abantu mu South Afirika ne New Zealand gye bayitira mu buweereza bw’okuteebereza embeera y’obudde – n’amawanga gombi galina obuwanja obw’ebbugumu obw’obuwanja, naye galina abantu ab’obungi obutali bumu n’embeera z’oku lubalama lw’ennyanja ezitali zimu.
Baayagala okuzuula emirundi abatuuze bano ab’oku lubalama gye bakozesa obusembayo bw’eggwanga oba obw’obusuubuzi, ensonga ze bakozeseramu era n’okumanya oba babulimuwa nga mulimu era nga beesigwa.
Ebyo bye bintu bya mukulu olw’engeri enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde ejja okukwata ku kuteebereza embeera y’obudde mu biseera ebijja.
Ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano byayankuliddwa abantu 31 okuva e South Africa ne 126 okuva e New Zealand.

Bano baali bawebako abakozesa enteebereza y’embeera y’obudde mu mirimu gyabwe (ng’abalobi n’ab’ekibiina ekikola ku kununula abantu mu mazzi), n’abalala abenyigira mu mizannyo egy’omu nnyanja n’ebikolwa eby’okwepumula gamba ng’okusubwa, okukuba ebyato, oba okuwugira.
Abanoonyereza baabuuza ku ngeri obujjanjabi bw’obwenge obw’ekirungi bwe buba bwe bunyamu, n’engeri ebiragiro byabwo gye bibeera by’amazima era nga bikwatagana.
Abantu abaali batabwe baawandiika ebintu ebyabafumbatako era nga by’omugaso, ne bagamba oba ebyo byandikyukira olw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Era baalina okwogera ku bukuumi bw’amawulire ge baweebwa ekitongole ky’eggwanga ekikola ku by’obudde, n’engeri gye baawuliramu ku byo.
Abasajja n’abakazi abasinga obungi abaava mu South Africa abaali mu kunoonyereza kuno baali abasubi, oba abayamba mu kunoonya n’okuwonya abantu oba mu mirimu gy’okunoonyereza.
Abantu abasinga obungi mu New Zealand abaayawula ebibuuzo baatunuulira ebiteebereza by’obudde kubanga baali baagala okukoma, okukuba oluguudo oba okuwummula mu nnyanja.
Abantu abaali beetabye okuva mu mawanga gombi baawuliriza amawulire ge baweebwa ebitongole by’eggwanga eby’embeera y’obudde.
Baasanyukira enkola z’okuteebereza ezituukiridde, ezitera okubaamu kituufu, ezirina obulungi okukozesa era nga ziriko ebintu ebisobola okukolerwako okuterekeza okusinziira ku byetaago byabwe.
Abantu abaakozesa omulimu guno olw’emirimu gyabwe mu bulijjo baalaba nti nteebereza z’embeera y’ennyanja okumpi n’okuwaawaawa tezaali ntuukirivu.
Obubaka bwa bitundu ebimu bwali bulungi okusinga obw’ebirala.
Abantu ba South Africa baali baasooka okukozesa obuweereza bw’embeera y’obudde okusinga abantu ba New Zealand, era baalukijjukirako okumala omulundi gumu buli lunaku.
Ku beetabi 9 ku buli 10, enkola ya kuteebereza ennungi nnyo yali ya muwendo nnyo.
Abasinga obungi baasalawo ku buweereza obwali buwa okulaba eby’omu maaso okumala ennaku ssatu okutuuka mu nnaku musanvu.
Abantu abaakola omulimu gw’okulunda ebyennyanja oba abaalina okuteekateeka ebintu nga waliwo embeera ey’obwongo oluusi baali baagala enteebereza ez’emyaka mingi n’ez’ebiseera by’omwaka.

Abasaba abasinga baali bakkiriza nti olw’okweyongera kw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde, obuweereza bw’okuteebereza bujja kwetaaga okukozesa amawulire amalungi agasinga agasigadde ku sayansi mu biseera eby’omu maaso okukakasa okuteebereza okutuukiridde.
Okunoonyereza kungi nga kuno tekulikoleddwa mu mawanga agali mu kibira kya Ddaala.
Abanoonyereza balowooza nti baasobola okuyiga bingi okuva ku beetabi okusinziira ku bibuuzo bye baababuuzizza.
Obunafu obulala obusoboka bwe buli nti abantu abasinga obungi ababeera e New Zealand okusinga ab’e South Africa be baatabira mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Omulimu gwabwe gujja kuyamba abantu abakolera mu buweereza bw’okuteebereza embeera y’obudde okukola ebyamaguzi ebirungi ebikuumira mu nkyukakyuka ebyetaago by’abakkiriya baabwe.
Bajja kusobola okukola enkyukakyuka n’okulongooseza ebintu okusinziira ku ngeri abakkiriya baabwe gye basanyukira era n’ensonga lwaki bakikozesa.
Engeri y’Okwetaba mu Kunoonyereza ku Bukozesa bw’Enkola z’Obulimi ezikuuma Obutonde:
Ekyokulabirako kya Lushoto
Eky'okutegeera eky'obulimi n'obulunzi obukuuma obutonde (CSA) kweyongera okufuna obukulu mu nsi yonna.
Kyokka, tekitangaazanga bulungi kye kigwanidde okubikkibwa wansi w’empagi zaayo esatu—okuyongera obungi bw’ebintu, okukakasa n’okwewala.
N’olwekyo, CSA ekwata enkola n’obuwangwa obw’enjawulo obw’obulimi, ekifuula ekizibu okussaawo ebigendererwa bya CSA.
Okusooka, tewali mitindo gya lwatu era egy’okukoleraako awamu n’enkola z’okumanya embeera y’obuwangwa obutonde bw’enkola.
Okusingira ddala, waliwo obubaka butono obukwata ku nsonga z’obuweerwa obw’enjawulo obumaze okutongozebwa nga CSA, naddala mu mawanga agakyakula.
Okusooka, okukulembeza CSA tekitwala mu mbeera endowooza z’abantu abali mu nsonga eno okukakasa nti obuyambi bulimu, bubulijjo era bulina omukisa ogw’okukkirizibwa.
Wano, tulageka enkola empya ey’okwetabamu ey’okumanya obulungi bw’obulimi n’obulunzi obukuuma obutonde mu mirimu gy’abalimi abasigadde.
Kino kiraga eby’okulabirako (n’ebitundu) eby’okufaananya eby’obulimi eby’emmere ey’okwerindisa n’okwegendereza mu nkyukakyuka z’obutonde bw’ensi.
Era kiwagira okutereka obubonero mu ngeri ey’okwetabamu, ekireeta okusooka okwekebejja embeera y’obutonde n’embeera y’omu maaso.
Enteekateeka eno yagezesebwa mu balimi 72 abaakozesa enkola ez’enjawulo ez’okukuuma obutonde mu kyalo kya Lushoto eky’embeera y’obudde ennungi, e Tanzania.

Abalimi naddala baasiima enkola ezaayongera ku buvubuka n’omutindo gw’ettaka, n’okukendeeza ku mazzi agayitamu ku luuyi lw’ettaka, n’okuddamu okukola ettaka eryonoonese olw’obuvunaanyizibwa obulungi ku amakungula n’obulimi bw’ebirime mu biseera ebitali bya buli mwaka.
Okusinga obugimu, enkola za CSA zaayongera ku kuzimba ensolo, kuzimba emmere, okukozesa emmere n’enfuna.
Enkola eno esobola okukwatibwa bulungi mu bitundu eby’enjawulo n’enkola za bulimi era ekiraga nti ebintu ebikulu by’okukolako bisobola okuteekebwa mu bifo ebisobola.
Naye tukiteesa nti CSA etwalibwe nga kye kimu ku nkola y’okukola obukugu, okwekenneenya n’okuyiga.
Amatendekezo agapya ag’okuketta gayamba bannassaayansi n’abalimi okuteeketera enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Bannassaayansi abakola ne balimi mu Tanzania kati basobola okupima obulungi bw’enkola empya ez’obulimi okusobozesa okukendeeza ku kukosebwa kw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Basuubira nti engeri yaabwe ejja kweyongera ku mmere ey’okwerindisa n’amakukungula g’abalimi mu bitundu ebirala eby’ensi.
“Obulimi n’obulunzi obukuuma obutonde” kye kimu ku ebyo Omuungwana gw’ensi yonna akubiriza okusobola okuyamba abalimi abalimu olutiba lutono okwetegekera enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Omulimi akuuma obutonde afuga enkyukakyuka z’embeera y’obudde era asobola okwongera ku mmere ey’okwerindisa ng’ayongera obungi bw’ebimera bye.
Kino kye kizibu ekikulu nnyo eri abalimi ba Tanzania, kubanga eggwanga limaze okufuna amakungula agatono g’ebirime ebikulu eby’emmere olw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.

Kyokka, abanoonyereza bagamba nti kizibu okupima obwatuufu bw’enkola ezikuuma obutonde, gamba ng’okukola omukono, era abalimi bennyini tebeekubirwaako buli kiseera okulaba obanga enkola zikola nga bwe zaali zitegeerezebwa.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okukola enkola ey’okupima obulungi bw’enkola ezikuuma embeera y’obudde, nga beetegefu ku kwongera ku mmere ey’okwerindisa n’okwekenneenya.
Mu kusooka, baasoma mu kunoonyereza okulala ku bulimi ne bakola akaluluka ka bitundu bibiri nga buli kimu kirimu ebintu 14, oba “ebikwata,” ebikulu mu kupima emmere ey’okwerindisa n’okwekenneenya.

Awo, nga bakolera mu disitulikiti y’e Lushoto mu Tanzania, abanoonyereza ne bakolera wamu n’abalimi b’omu kitundu n’abakugu mu byobulimi okusobola okuzuula eby’enjawulo ebikulu okuva mu buli lukalala.
Abalimi baalaga nti okukola emmere kye kintu ekikulu ennyo ekigendererwa okulaba nga wabaawo emmere ey’okwerindisa.
Mu ngeri endala, obutabanguko bwonna obwongerera ku amakungula g’ebirime byabwe bwali bwa muwendo nnyo.
Kyokka, ku nsonga y’okwekenneenya, abalimi baali baagala nnyo obuyambi obubayamba okukuuma ettaka ly’ebintu byabwe, n’obubayamba okwongera ku kumanya kwabwe, obukugu, n’emali.
Bwe baamala okumanya obukulu bw’ekyoleko buli kimu, baasobola okubikozesa okugeza oba engeri mukaaga ez’okujjanjaba mu Lushoto zaali zaafuluma.
Mu buli kifo, baabuuza abalimi b’omu kitundu, ku lutiba oluva ku 1-5, oba waabaddewo okweyongera mu buli kintu okuva omulimu gwatandika.
Kino kyabawa omukisa okukiraba ekyo ku byo ebyakolera ku emmere ey’okwerindisa n’okuguŋŋumira.
Baazuula nti 3 ku bikolebwa 6 ebyakozesebwa byokka bye byalina omuwendo.
Ebyo byali ebimera ebyakolerwanga omukutu, ebigumira ekyeya, era nga biwa emmere ennungi ennyama.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola yaabwe etera okwanguyiriza okukakasa nti enkola ezijja mu maaso zijjukira ebyetaago by’abalimi ba Lushoto awamu n’ebigendererwa by’obulimi obukuuma obutonde.

Baagattako nti okusalawo ku ngeri ennungi ez’okuyamba nakyo kyongera omukisa gw’okuba nti abalimi bajja kuteesa abatuuze baabwe enkola ennungi, nga bwe batambuza ebirowoozo eby’obulimi obukuuma obutonde.

Mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, enkola eno esobola okukozesebwa mu bitundu ebirala, era esobola okuyamba okukakasa nti enkola ezikuuma obutonde ziteekateeka embeera z’omu bitundu n’okumanya kw’abalimi mu bujjuvu okuyitira mu kkulirwako n’okwekebejja.
Bwetyo, enteekateeka z’obulimi n’obulunzi obukuuma obutonde zirina amagoba ag’okuba n’obulungi era okufuna obukulu, mu Tanzania ne mu nsi endala za Afrika.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa omukago gwa bannassaayansi okuva mu Kenya ne Budaaki.
Obuwuka obuleeta Endwadde mu Bisolo ebirimu Egitundu ekikola nga Ebitonde ebirumbaganyi: Ebyo bye Tulowoozezza okuva mu South Africa
Okwekenneenya ebitonde ebivaako obulwadde nga olulyo olugwira tekyaddibwa ku kisaanikira mu kusoma okukwata ku bulumbaganyi bw’ebitonde.
Obuwuka obuleeta endwadde obutali bwa wano busobola okuba n’obuzibu bungi ku bitonde ebyalamu, obutonde bw’ebitundu bye bituulamu, n’eby’enfuna ebyo butonde bw’ebitundu bye busisinkana.

Mu ssuula eno, tukozesa ebyokulabirako by’endwadde ezaayingiziddwa mu nsolo ez’ewaka n’ez’omu nsiko (ekikwekweto ky’embwa, obuwuka obw’obuwuka mu nnyama, n’endwadde y’ennyama), n’abantu (obuwuka obw’omusujja, omusujja gw’abaana, n’akawoka ka HIV) okusobola okwoleka engeri obuwuka obuleeta endwadde bwe buyinza okukola.

Okuvangawo okusinga okw’amaanyi okutuukirira kati kwabadde kwa rinderpest, ekyaleetera ensolo ez’ennyama okuba obukadde okufa, era nga kyakazimbye ebika by’ensolo ez’omu nsiko mu bitundu bingi eby’obukiikaddyo bwa Afrika.
Kino kyongedde okukosa ennyo ebyenfuna by’ekitundu, era kyavuddemu enkyukakyuka ez’enjawulo mu nteekateeka n’engeri obutonde bw’ensi bwe butambulira.

Endwadde ya rinderpest emaziddwa mu nsi yonna, naye endwadde eva ku kulumwa embwa n’endwadde ya kafulensi mu nsolo ez’ennyama zikyaliwo, era kijja kwetaagisa okwegendereza n’okulabirira okweyongera okubikuuma.
Mu bulwadde bw’abantu, ebiseera ebikwata ku kikungulu kibadde kiwonyezebwa mu nsi yonna, naye omulimu gw’obulwadde obwali bwetooloddwa abakoloni b’omu Bulaaya gwali mubi nnyo.

Mu ntandikwa za myaka gya 1700, abantu ba Khoekhoe abasinga obungi (okutuuka ku 90% mu bibiina ebimu) baafa, ne bamenyaamenya obulamu bwabwe n’obuwangwa bwabwe, era abasigaddewo batono ne baweebwa omulimu gw’okukolera ku bibbira.
HIV, eyasangibwa mu South Afirika mu 1982, era erinawo omulimu omungi, era eddagala lya antiretroviral liweza gavumenti obuwumbi 66.4 za ZAR buli mwaka.
Tulina n’akaawuka ka West Nile n’akaawuka k’omusujja gw’embizzi z’e Afirika nga bye bintu ebyokulabirako eby’endwadde ezaava mu Afirika, era eziyinza okwonoona ensi yonna.
Tutegeera nti endwadde empya zijja okuvaayo nga bantu beeyongera okutuukirira mu bitundu eby’obutonde, era nga obuwumbi bw’ebyobusuubuzi bweyongera.
Ebyo bannassaayansi bye bamanyi ku bitonde ebitono ebivaako endwadde mu South Africa

Ssuula eno mu kitabo eno ekuŋŋaanya amawulire agakadde ku ndwadde gamba nga rinderpest, ekikumba, omusujja gw’abaana, ne HIV, zonna zireetebwa obutonde obwonoonyi (akawuka, obulwadde obutono, n’ebitonde ebirala ebitono ebiweebwa olugero lw’olulyo olwonoonyi, kitegeeza nti tebisangibwa mu butonde mu kifo ekimu).
Endwadde zino zonna zikosa ensolo n’abantu mu South Africa, era okubalukawo kwazo kuggwaako okwonoona ebyenfuna by’eggwanga.

Mu kifo ky’okunoonyereza ekiyitibwa ‘okunoonyereza ku bitonde eby’obulabe’, bannabyabufuzi bannyonnyola ebitonde ebikula bulungi era ne bikosa ebintu oluvannyuma lw’okuteekebwa mu bifo ebipya gye bitaba.
Okunoonyereza okusinga kukuumye ku bitonde ebirumbaganyi ebinene gamba nga bimera n’ensolo, naye n’ebitonde ebitono ebitabalika ebiyambaza endwadde bikulu.
Mu ssuula eno, abawandiisi baayogera ku ndwadde ezimu ez’ebisolo n’abantu eziri mu South Africa, ezibaleetebwa obulwadde obwava ebweru.
Bagamba nti endwadde eyali ey’akabi ennyo ye ‘rinderpest’, eyafunibwamu mu South Africa mu mwaka gwa 1896.
Obulwadde bwa rinderpest bwali buvudde mu kawuka era bwakwata ente n’embogo.
Akawuka kamu ke kaaleetera abantu obulwadde bw’ekikamwa.
Abantu bangi ab’omu byalo baalumwa enjala oluvannyuma lw’okubalukawo kw’obulwadde mu 1896, naye kati bumaze okumala olw’okutema eggala.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti wakati wa 1772 ne 1861, embwa nyingi mu South Africa zaalwala endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo, wadde nga abantu tebaamanyi nti endwadde ki eno.
Nga 1893, kyali kimanyise nti endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo yavanga ku akawuka, n’olwekyo gavumenti yasalawo okutta embwa ezaalwako endwadde ne kugemesa ezo ezaali tezinaako.
Kyokka, kino tekyazikiriza ndwadde eno era yakwata ensolo nnyingi ez’omu nsiko gamba nga obusika, empologoma, embwa ez’omu nsiko, amagunju n’ebibe.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti mu 1928, abaana babiri baakubwa kakolwa era nebafa olw’endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo.
Okuva olwo, endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo eeyongedde okweyoleka mu South Africa.
Baagamba nti mu 1954, Abasouth Afirika bangi nabo baakwatibwa akawuka ka mumps.
Bwe kyakyawandiikibwa essuulu lino, akawuka ka measles kaali katta abaana nga 400 buli lunaku.
Baagamba nti kikung'aali kyeeyongera mu bifo abantu n'ente mwe baali bali kumpi.
Abalunzi era baayogera ku bulwadde bwe bayita akafuba k’ente (BTB), akaleetebwa akawuka ka bakitiriya.
Obulwadde bwa BTB bwakwata ente, ennyama, enkoko, ensolo ez’ennyama, empologoma, ensolo eza kudus, enkumbi n’empologoma.
Baagamba nti obulwadde bwa BTB bwali bumaze okubikkulirwa mu ppaaka y’eggwanga eya South Africa mu 1996.
Gavumenti yaziyiza obulwadde obwo ng’etta embogo ezaali zirwadde.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti akawuka akalala, akayingiziddwa mu South Africa abantu abava mu Bulaaya, kavaako endwadde eyitibwa ‘kakwata’.
Obulwadde bwo butta abantu ba Khoekhoe abasukka mu 90%.
Mu kiseera eky’enkomerero y’okusaasaana kw’endwadde, omuntu gw’abantu ba Khoekhoe gaali gwakendedde nnyo.
Abawandiisi era baategeeza ku kawuka akalwanyiisa obugendereze bw’omuntu (HIV) akavuddemu obulwadde bwa AIDS.
Abasayansi bakyalirowooza nti akawuka kaasooka okuva ku nsolo ne kajja mu bantu, mu nkola ekiyitibwa zoonosis.
Akawuka kaasangibwa mu South Afirika mu 1982.
Baagamba nti, mu 2019, HIV teyaliiko ddagala erigema wadde eddagala ery’okuwonya.
Baakomekkereza essuula nga boogera ku Kawuka ka West Nile n’Akawuka k’Enkoko z’e Ng’ombe, nga bagamba nti byava mu Afrika ne biyanguwa okugenda e Bulaaya ne Amerika.
Akawuuka ka West Nile kaasaasaanyizibwa ensiri era ne katta ennyonyi nnyingi, naye ne kakosa embalaasi n’abantu.
Baagamba nti ensolo ng’empologoma n’embizzi z’omu nsiko zaasaanyizza obulwadde bw’akaawa k’embizzi z’omu Afirika.
Obulwadde obwo bwakosa embizzi, era bwakosa nnyo emirimu gy’okulunda embizzi.
Bawandiisi bagamba nti baayogera ku ndwadde eziviirwa mu bakitiriya n’akawuka aka virus bokka, n’olwekyo essuula eno si lunnyiriri olujjuvu lw’obuwuka obwonna obutuuka mu mubiri.
Abaawandiika baava mu South Africa.
Enkola y’okujjanjaba eky’obujjanjabi ekwata ku bukakafu obw’obujulizi bw’okuwona kwa  Odontogenic keratocyst
Okulongoosa obulungi ekikulukuto kya  odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kikyali kintu ekikulu era ekikyamu mu bitabo by’obujjanjabi bw’ennwawo n’amagulu.
Mu kiseera kino, tewali kigendererwa kya buli muntu ku ngeri esingayo obulungi ey’okujjanjaba abalwadde abalina endwadde y’amenyo ag’amaanyi.

Mu ngeri za bujjanjabi ez’enjawulo eziriwo, tewali ngeri yonna ekiraze nti tewali kuddamu kw’ekikulukuto oba kyetaagisa okuddamu okutwalibwawo okutaliimu, okuggyako okuggyawo ekikulukuto kyonna n’okulekawo akatundu akatono.

Olw’obutabeerawo kwa bukakafu bw’ebigambo eby’okujjanjaba abalwadde abalina ekizibu ky’odontogenic keratocyst mu bitabo, kunoonyereza kuno kugenderera okuteekawo enkola y’okujjanjaba, esigamiziddwa ku biva mu kunoonyereza kw’ebibalo, erina essuubi ery’okuyamba mu kutumbula enzijanjaba y’abalwadde abalina ekizibu kino.

Ng’okozesa ebipimo bya; obuwufu, ekika ky’ekibwa (ekikulu oba ekikyusiddwa), ekibwa ekirwaddemu abantu bangi oba ekimu, obuwuka obwonoona amalusu, n’obuwuka obw’enjawulo; tulaga omulamwa gw’okusalawo, okuyamba mu kulondawo enzijanjaba n’okufuna omukisa omutono ow’okuddamu okufuna obulwadde mu kujjanjaba ekibwa ky’amenyo.
Abanoonyereza bateesa engeri ezisingako okujjanjaba obulwadde bw’amasusu.

Mu kukozesa awamu ebibala by’okunoonyereza okw’emabega, abanoonyereza baategeka entambula eyo y’obulongoofu abasawo gye bayinza okukolera okutonda n’okujanjaba abalwadde abalina obulwadde bw’amasubi oluyitibwa ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
OKC lye zigiro, oba ekikula ekitali kya bulijjo, ku mannyo g’omuntu.
Abasawo basanga embeera eno kizibu okugijjanjaba, era abalwadde batera okufuna endwadde endala ya OKC ne oluvannyuma lw’okuwona.
Abasawo kyeyava basunsula engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okujjanjaba amalwadde gano ag’omu kamwa mu bujjuvu era eteriiko bukyamu.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonya  ebigendererwa ebikulu abasawo bye basaana okukola okusobola okuzuula n’okujanjaba endwadde eyo.
Baakikola nga banoonya mu biwandiiko ebyaliwo, oba mu bitundu by’okunoonyereza, eby’OKC.
Baali baagala nnyo okufuna amawulire agakwata ku ngeri abasawo gye baakolamu ku OKC mu bbanga lya mwaka gumu, nga bwe kyali kibikiddwa mu bitundu 46 bye baazuula.
Abanoonyereza baazuula nti OKC yasinga okubalabika mu basajja okusinga mu bakyala, era eyinza okukwata abantu okutuuka ku myaka 90, wadde nga yasinga okubalabika wakati w’emyaka 20 ne 30.
Obulwadde bwakose ebikwaŋŋa eby’awansi.
Obulwadde bwa OKC butandika mu gwama, okuwuluka kw’akakomo kuliko kuwoneka oluvannyuma.
Abalwadde baasanga nga balumwa era nga balina omusaayi (amazzi, gamba nga obutonto, agava mu kibwa oba mu kibonerezo), era enkombe z’amenyo gaabwe zisobola okugenda mu bifo ebitali bya bulijjo.
Baateesa nti abasawo baggyayo ekibikwa kyonna n’amenyo agali okumpi.

Bwe ziggyibwawo, basaanidde okuteekaako eddagala eriyitibwa Carnoy’s solution, awamu n’omukka ogubisi (omukka ogubisi ennyo ogukozesebwa okuggyawo olususu olwonooneka mangu) ne fluorouracil (erimanyikiddwa nga 5FU, eddagala ery’ekkookolo erikozesebwa nnyo).
Oluvannyuma lw’obujjanjabi buno, abanoonyereza baateesa nti omulwadde asaanidde okwekebejjebwa bulijjo okumala emyaka 25.
Baagamba nti obujjanjabi buno bwe bulungi ennyo ku bizigiro ebitono okusinga akatunda k’omusota (3 cm).
Ku bunafu obuzingiramu omusaawo gwa sentimita 3, abanoonyereza baateesa nti waliwo okwetegereza okusingawo.
Baagamba nti abasawo basaanidde okusooka okukendeeza ku bwanyigirizi mu kibikwa ekyo n’okuggyawo amazzi, era n’okuggyawo obugoma bwonna obuli ku lusu lw’ekikono.
Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, ggumba liteekebwa mu madagala ga Carnoy.
Baateesa nti abasawo basaanidde okukolako ku balwadde bano buli myezi 2 okumala emyaka 2.
Bwe kiba nti omulwadde alina ebizigiro bingi, abasawo bayinza n’okubisaanyaamu nga bakozesa ebyuma ebikulu eby’omu malwaliro.
Naye mu bujjuvu, okunoonyereza okwekebejje kwalaga nti mu mbeera nyingi, singa abasawo baggyawo ekizibe ne bassaako 5FU, abalwadde tebakomawo na OKC.
Wabula baalabula nti obujulizi bw’obujjanjabi obwo tebwalimu bukakafu buli kiseera, era baafuna ebiwandiiko bya sayansi bitono ku nsonga eno.

Ate era abanoonyereza tebaakola ge bigezo byabwe okusobozesa okuwa amagezi gano; wabula baagezaako okuŋŋaanya enkola z’obujjanjabi ezisinga obulungi ezaategeerezebwa okuva mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa abanoonyereza abalala.
Abanoonyereza bano, abaali mu Nigeria ne USA, kyeyava bateesa okuba nti wabeerewo okunoonyereza okulala mu mawanga amalala okusobola okugezaako obulungi bw’enkola y’obujjanjabi eteezebwa wano.
Era baakubiriza abasawo okuteesa ku mbeera endala ez’abalwadde mu kiseera ky’okujjanjaba.
Eddagala erigema ery’akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), MERS-CoV ne SARSr-CoV: Okugerageranya okukozesa kompyuta okusobola okuteesa epitope ez’okugezesa.

Akawuka ka kolona bulijjo kaba kakwata ku buli kika kya nsolo, eky’ennyama nnyama oba eby’ebinyonyi okusinziira ku buli kika kyako; kyokka, akawuka kano oluusi kasobola okukyukira ku nsolo endala olw’okufuukafuuka.
HCoV-229E y’emu ku kawuka ka kolona ka bantu mukaaga, nga mulimu ne HCoV-NL63, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-HKU1, MERS-CoV ne SARSr-CoV (SARSr-CoV-1 ne SARS-CoV-2), era gasambiddwa mu nsi yonna.
MERS-CoV ne SARS-CoV-2 biyinza okusigala ku bintu ebitali bulamu gamba nga (ekyuma, glasi oba pulaasitiki okutuusa ku nnaku mwenda) (Huang, C.-L, 2020).
Engeri z’okwewala obulwadde n’okujjanjabwa kw’eddagala erya Hydroxychloroquine bya mugaso, naye eddagala erigema erikola obulungi liyinza okwetaagibwa okukomya okusaasaana kw’akawuka ka covid-19.
Ekigendererwa ky’okunoonyereza kwaffe kyali okumanya ebintu ebiyinza okuba eddagala erigema nga tukozesa enkola ez’ebibalo kannabulamu.
Ebikozesebwa n'Enkola

Endagabutonde eziwera ez’akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 zaafunibwa okuva mu 2019 Novel Coronavirus Resource (2019nCoVR) ne tterekero bibiri, nga mubaddemu  National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID) ne TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver ez’okukozesa ku mutindo gwa kompyuta.

Tujja kubuulirirako obuwanvu ku lwakiri lw’akawuka, tugeraageranye obubaka bw’enjawulo okusobola okumanya ebitundu ebikuumirwa, ekifo eky’ekirungi ekisinga okubonekagana (ekifo eky’okukwatagana n’ekiruubirirwa), n’okukola enkyusakyusa ey’omukutu ogw’omukisa ogw’omoolekyu (epitope) ey’okuyamba mu kulwanyisa obulwadde 2019-nCoV, SARSr-CoV, ne MERS-CoV ebipya.
Kyenkanyi, okugerageranya ensengeka wakati wa SARS-CoV-2 n’ekika ekirala kyalaze nti ebisigalira ebiri mu kitundu ekikwata ku kifunyi bikuumirwa nnyo n’obufaanana bwa 70%.
